title.native: Summer Pockets

sampleCharacters.name: Shiroha Naruse
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Shiroha is the main heroine of Summer Pockets. She is a calm and shy girl who doesn’t have any friends. While she is anxious around strangers, she is also well-composed. Other than her blood-related grandfather, she has nobody who can even be called a friend. She was a loner for a bit too long, so she’s somewhat socially awkward. She frequently gazes over the sea on the isolated island.

sampleCharacters.name: Kamome Kushima
sampleCharacters.description: Kamome is a mysterious girl who is seen from time to time on the island, and is always dragging a big suitcase along with her. She uses the suitcase in many clever ways and when it gets annoying, she just rides on top of it. It seems that, like Hairi, she came to the island for just this summer. She has a bad habit of meddling with things out of pure curiosity and getting herself in danger, so it's sort of hard to leave her on her own. It looks like she came to the island to search for something. In her hands is an old map… "This is a treasure map!"

sampleCharacters.name: Ao Sorakado
sampleCharacters.description: Ao is a girl who doesn't care about genders and talks to everyone like they're her friend, and has a tendency to purposefully ignore everything love-related. Ao acts like one of the core members of a local boy-scouts-like group; promptly taking command of any situation. She may not seem like it, but she is a covert pervert. Ao frequently mishears words and misinterprets them in a erotic way, only to become bashful herself. She works part-time at the island's candy shop, and the local kids call her "Sensei''. If she has the time, she can sleep anywhere.

sampleCharacters.name: Tsumugi Wenders
sampleCharacters.description: Tsumugi is a calm and honest half-German girl who decided to use this summer vacation to, "look for things she wants to do". Her personal philosophy is, "Classic books and rules were polished over time to be as rational as possible". Because of that, she even follows rules that clearly don't fit modern society. She is a bit lenient though, and doesn't try to force others to follow those rules. For someone who always talks about rules and logic, whenever she loses a debate, she moans with a mortifying "Mugyu~". Even though she is a calm and collected girl and it feels like she can do anything, sometimes she just blankly stares somewhere or starts talking in monotone. And then there are times when her clothes are frayed like she just rampaged through the mountains. She unexpectedly has a lot of weak points.

sampleCharacters.name: Umi Katou
sampleCharacters.description: Umi is the second cousin of Hairi Takahara who has lived her whole life in the city, but she always admired life in the countryside and it’s the reason why she has come to Torishirojima for the summer. During the summer, she often cooks for Hairi. Her specialty is fried rice; she's extremely passionate about fried rice. ~!She is the daughter of Hairi and Shiroha in the future.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Hairi Takahara
sampleCharacters.description: Hairi is a young man who is not a native to Torishirojima, as he grew up in a more urban area. He used to be a dedicated swimmer at his high school in the city, but after a certain incident he is now afraid of going into the water. Due to said incident, he uses the recent death of his grandmother as an excuse to come to the island for the summer to take care of her estate sale.

sampleCharacters.name: Shizuku Mizuori
sampleCharacters.description: Shizuku is the student council president at the heroines' school on the mainland. During summer vacation, she travels to the island to meet with Tsumugi. She has an extraordinary love and respect for breasts. It's not that she's interested in women; she just has a pure admiration for breasts.

sampleCharacters.name: Miki Nomura
sampleCharacters.description: Nomiki is a girl who lives on the island who is a member of the Torishirojima Public Order Executives, protecting the island's morals daily. She's also in charge of radio broadcasts across the island, and will keep lookout for troublemakers from atop the radio tower. She carries her own customized water gun called the "Hydro Gladiator Kai" in order to mercilessly punish evildoers.

sampleCharacters.name: Ryouichi Mitani
sampleCharacters.description: Ryouichi is a local on Torishirojima. He can often be seen running around shirtless in the name of freedom. This often causes a conflict with Nomiki, as she considers it indecent. He can often be seen hanging out in his and Tenzen’s secret base.

sampleCharacters.name: Tenzen Kanou
sampleCharacters.description: Tenzen is a local on Torishirojima. On the outside, he looks very serious and cool. However, he has dedicated too much of his time to table tennis, so his speech and manners are often very unusual. He brought a ping pong table to his and Ryouichi's secret base and trains rigorously every day.

sampleCharacters.description: A novice female adventurer. She names the kitten she found in the labyrinth "Tama" and keeps him as her pet. She specializes in high-speed combat, taking advantage of her skill, "Acceleration." She has a diligent and kind-hearted personality, but when it comes to Tama, she sometimes displays hints of a rather intense fetish. (Source: Official Site)

She’s good friends with Feri, and the two of them both love sweets. (Source: Official Site)

sampleCharacters.name: Feri

She’s good friends with Lily, and both of them dream of visiting a human city one day. (Source: Official Site)

In contrast to her young appearance, she is always calm, collected, and rational, and is the sole leader of the chain of command for her companions.

sampleCharacters.name: Albert Einstein

She intensely dislikes men, even objecting to other women interacting with them.

sampleCharacters.name: Touya Senji

Whenever he gets punched, he shouts out the name of the apple variety.

sampleCharacters.name: Juubei Yagyu
sampleCharacters.description: __Talent:__ A talent that allows one to push visual perception to its absolute limit. She is a warrior who pursues the pinnacle of swordsmanship, traveling around the country and facing off against the followers of sword masters from all over the country.

sampleCharacters.name: Charlotte Corday

sampleCharacters.name: Nostradamus

sampleCharacters.name: Koinzell
sampleCharacters.description: Koinzell is a new name taken by one of the falsely-labeled Lances of Betrayal, Ascheriit. Back in his youth he was an orphan who was accepted as a student in Ms. Gleaa's school of swordsmanship, where he accomplished such feats, especially the learning of the infamous Black Wing sword technique, that made him the new heir of the title of Blade Master, an ancient honour for those deemed true master swordsmen. He then became one of the fourteen youths chosen to carry the Emperor's spears and end the war with Wischtech, and was also one of the four to accomplish their mission, only to be betrayed and brutally murdered by their fellow companions, those who became known as the Seven Heroes. After having his left eye gouged out by Glenn, his best friend, and his body minced to pieces, he was left for dead but managed to survive by feeding on a fairy, which regenerated him at the expense of mixing his human blood with that of the faeries, thus giving him the appearance of a feminine child with pale hair and skin and red eyes. Koinzell is regarded as one of the best fighters in the series, due to not only to his swordsmanship, which include the fabled Black Wing, but also because he can create massive black chainswords from his right wrist. He is shown to be usually cold, and very brutal and ruthless when hunting down those who betrayed him, but can also be very caring, often putting himself at risk for others. That is due to that although revenge motivates him, he is still the hero which he was before being betrayed by his friends. He is empowered by the twin moons of the world, and if too fatigued he shrinks into a child fairy until recovered.

sampleCharacters.name: Elseria Rahnclave
sampleCharacters.description: The daughter of the Imperial Elector, Aleczalt Rahnclave, and a knight of the Seven Lances. She first meets the main character, Koinzell, at the town of Jullas Abllas. It is also there that her view of the once traitor and enemy to the empire changes into something more. The Rhanclave family is one of the eight families that have the power to elect a succeeding emperor. It is also said that the Rhanclave family is over 1000 years old and specializes in fighting. She also has a strong sense of justice as her reason for joining the Seven Lances was only to protect the people and the emperor.

sampleCharacters.name: Ato Kusharundo
sampleCharacters.description: Ato is the third princess of the Kusharundo clan. She looks up to her brother, Kurato, and by dressing up as a boy, she could fight alongside him. After she witness Koinzell kill her brother, she couldn't accept the fact that he died and sought revenge for Kurato. She wore "The Black Dress of Vengeance" to seek revenge and tried to kill Koinzell, but eventually, she realized that Koinzell helped put Kurato out of his suffering and joined him on his quest. ~!Koinzell saves Ato's life by giving her his blood, giving her some power like his.!~ Her arsenal of weapons include a long Dual Bladed sword and various Magical Talismans. ~!Is later given a double bladed sword, crafted by Koinzell. He said her skills suited that style of weapon.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Peepi
sampleCharacters.description: Peepi is a young elf girl whose village, Miruel Mirael, is slaughtered. She attempts to escape by smuggling herself to another area, though she is caught, and saved by Köinzell. Though she has the choice to join another village, she decides to stay with Köinzell. Her real name has yet to be revealed.

She is a close friend of Vid, who introduces Köinzell to her. She agrees to smuggle them after Köinzell agrees to have sex with her, though the smuggling plan soon falls short. Her business is destroyed, and she decides to travel with Köinzell, especially because he reminds her of a close friend.

sampleCharacters.name: Shiki Granbell
sampleCharacters.description: Shiki, the main protagonist of the story, is a friendly yet socially awkward boy who's the sole human denizen of the Granbell Kingdom, a fantasy theme park on the planet Granbell inhabited by robots. He possesses an ability called Ether Gear, which is inherited from the park's animatronic Demon King, granting its user powers akin to those of a machine; Shiki uses a variation known as "Satan Gravity" that allows him to alter and redirect his own personal gravity. Encouraged by his artificial family to go out and make some real friends, he gets swept up on a journey with Rebecca to see new worlds across the cosmos.

sampleCharacters.name: Rebecca Bluegarden
sampleCharacters.description: Rebecca Bluegarden, the female protagonist, is a kind and energetic girl from the planet Blue Garden who travels to different planets to record videos of and upload to her channel on Aoneko, a video-sharing website, with the goal of obtaining one million subscribers. She pilots a spaceship called the Aqua Wing, which also functions as a seaboat. Rebecca's power, Leaper, is an Ether Gear that enhances her jumping ability, giving her great speed and agility.

sampleCharacters.name: Homura Kougetsu
sampleCharacters.description: Homura Kougetsu is a member of the Demon King's crew on Edens Zero, and a self-described knight from Planet Blue Garden. Her power, Soul Blade, is a type of Ether Gear that allows her to create bladed weapons made of Ether.

sampleCharacters.name: Hermit Mio
sampleCharacters.description: Hermit Mio is an android who's the member of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Master Code, is a type of Program Hacking. Hermit likes clothes and video games, and used to dislike humans, but not anymore.

sampleCharacters.name: Weisz Steiner
sampleCharacters.description: Weisz is a member of Edens Zero and a former thief from the Planet Norma. His power is Machina Maker, an Ether Gear that manipulates machines. Weisz is a selfish, stubborn, and vain man with a perverted side. However, he does care for his friends, and shows concern for others in his own way. Weisz likes money and bunny girls, and dislikes studying. ~!He is also the younger version of Professor Weisz from the year X442.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Sister  Ivry
sampleCharacters.description: Sister Ivry is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Heal Atomizer, is a Healing Ether ability that allows her to mend wounds, undo negative status effects, and repair living machines. Sister is short tempered, enjoys teasing, and has a laid-back attitude, but she is also dutiful and can be friendly to her allies. She has a sadistic side and enjoys torture. She dislikes things that can't be healed. Sister is shown to be someone who cannot accept death as a finality for machines, going as far to believe machines can be brought back by using the cloud's stored data.

sampleCharacters.name: Witch  Regret
sampleCharacters.description: Witch Regret is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. She is responsible for defending Edens Zero. Her power, Shield Ether, allows her to produce barriers made of Ether. Witch is very dutiful and holds a deep respect to Ziggy and his adoptive grandson Shiki. Although she is usually emotionless, Witch is capable of showing emotions. She finds it embarrassing to show her face to other people.

sampleCharacters.name: Happy
sampleCharacters.description: Happy is a machine cat from the planet Excede, Rebecca Bluegarden's companion, and a member of the Edens Zero's crew. His ability "Happy Blasters" allows him to transform into a pair of guns that fire Ether bullets. These bullets are powerful enough to incapacitate their targets, but won't kill them. ~!Happy was a cat found by Rebecca when he was young. He instantly became friends with her due to them sharing common life events. He received his name "Happy" from Rebecca for making her happy by becoming her friend. Sometime later, an accident occurred where a drunk driver ran over Happy, which ended up killing him. Thanks to Professor Weisz, he was revived into a machine body and continued his friendship with Rebecca.!~

sampleCharacters.name: E.M. Pino
sampleCharacters.description: Pino is a miniature anti-bot machine who joins the crew of Edens Zero. She can emit bursts of electromagnetic pulses, also known as EMP, that short out electronics for a few seconds and cancel out Ether Gear when it's in use. Her digital avatar resembles a young human girl with rabbit-like ears. She wears a necktie that is decorated with a single large heart.

sampleCharacters.name: Xiaomei
sampleCharacters.description: Xiaomei is shown to have a calm and serious disposition as well as knowledgeable due to her precognition abilities. Due to her precognition abilities not being able to tell a single outcome, it is shown that Xiaomei has an interest in watching people battle and this interest grows to the point where she becomes visibly excited and aroused.

sampleCharacters.name: Labilia Christy
sampleCharacters.description: Labilia Christy is an adventurer and B-Cuber who works at the Shooting Starlight guild.

sampleCharacters.name: Jinn
sampleCharacters.description: Jinn is a cyborg who was in the team "Rogue Out". His power, Wind Rage, is a type of Ether Gear that uses wind similarly to a typhoon. Jinn likes his sister Kleene and dislikes any man that approaches her. ~!After Rogue Out, he works under Drakken Joe with his sister, Kleene.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Kleene Rutherford
sampleCharacters.description: She is the element of the wind of the Element 4 under the command of Drakken Joe. Her power, Wind Snatch, is a form of Ether Gear that allows her to manipulate wind to steal anything in the vicinity. Jinn is her elder brother. Kleene likes her brother and anything cute, and dislikes spam messages.

sampleCharacters.name: Laguna Husert
sampleCharacters.description: Laguna Husert is the element of water in the Element 4 under Drakken Joe. He is also an actor. Laguna's power is Tears Lover, a type of Ether Gear that can turn anyone who sheds a tear into water. He likes fashion and dislikes dryness.

sampleCharacters.name: Mosco
sampleCharacters.description: Mosco is a machine tasked with the chores on board of the Edens Zero and a former mercenary from the team Rogue Out. He is an expert sumo wrestler who uses sumo techniques to fight. He likes Sister and little animals, but dislikes ghosts.

sampleCharacters.name: Drakken Joe
sampleCharacters.description: He is one of the Oración Seis Galáctica, the former owner of the Belial Gore, and the most notorious man in the Sakura Cosmos underworld. Element 4 is under his order.

sampleCharacters.name: Noah Glenfield
sampleCharacters.description: He is the Director of the Galactic Intelligence Agency in the Sakura Cosmos. He is currently working undercover as the Guild Master of Shooting Starlight. His Ether Gear is name Eye of God, he can observe where people are with that.

sampleCharacters.name: Poseidon Shura
sampleCharacters.description: Shura is a cruel and sadistic young man who feels entitled to everything in the Aoi Cosmos, including people due to being the son of The Emperor. He will kill any that displeases him. In front of his father he masks his true personality and acts the role of the respectful son. Additionally, he also wields gravity Ether gear.

sampleCharacters.name: Poseidon Nero
sampleCharacters.description: He is a member of the Oracion Seis Galáctica like Elsie Crimson and Drakken Joe. He rules over the Aoi Cosmos.

sampleCharacters.name: Brigandine
sampleCharacters.description: He is a machine and one of the Demon King's Four Dark Stars.

sampleCharacters.name: Fie
sampleCharacters.description: He is the Fire Element of the Element 4 under Drakken Joe.

sampleCharacters.name: Yoimaru Azaki

Digitally inept, he can only fight dead accounts by converting his spiritual energy to digital using a special fan - while incredibly powerful, it's only a fraction of his power in its prime. Zero immunity to women.

sampleCharacters.name: Sougo Kutani
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm Despite being the eldest son of the Kutani family, a prestigious family of Exorcists in Shikoku, due to advanced educational policies, he was given a smartphone before he was even an adult, and became an omnipotent user from the moment he opened his eyes. As he suffered from Internet solicitation from a young age, his personality became distorted, and he grew up as a prankster who lured men into romance scams to kill his boredom.

sampleCharacters.name: Mina Kouchi

Upon entering Miden Academy, he found in Minoru Wagari someone who showed him both hatred and appreciation, which was the best thing that could have happened to him.

sampleCharacters.description: She is a blind, gentle human woman who works as an office worker at the "Tonome Detective Agency." She has a keen sense of hearing, smell, and touch. She is a romance novice and is flustered by Tounome's approach.

sampleCharacters.name: Akira Tounome
sampleCharacters.description: A detective at the "Tonome Detective Agency," he is an invisible, gentlemanly non-human. He can make not only his own appearance but also the clothes he is wearing completely invisible. He is attracted to Yakou.

sampleCharacters.name: Luna Jarashi
sampleCharacters.description: A beastwoman investigator at the Tonome Detective Agency, primarily handling security and heavy lifting. She has a big-sister personality and is highly proactive, though she can be a bit careless at times. She nervously watches over the distance between Tonome and Yako while rooting for them.

sampleCharacters.name: Daichi Kikira
sampleCharacters.description: Tonome Detective Agency investigator, a human male primarily responsible for information gathering. Appears blunt but is actually meticulous. Tsundere. Keeps romance separate from work.

sampleCharacters.name: Karma Amanecer
sampleCharacters.description: A Dark Elf who runs the tea and light specialty shop “Elf Garden” with his wife, Light. He possesses the power of “curses,” and when anxious, he sometimes unknowingly curses those around him. A playful mood-maker, though he occasionally loses control...?

sampleCharacters.name: Light Festus
sampleCharacters.description: A White Elf who runs the tea and karma specialty shop “Elf Garden” with her husband Karma. Possesses the power of “blessing” and can bestow divine protection. Though gentle and kind-hearted, she also possesses the strength to rein in Karma's reckless behavior.

sampleCharacters.name: Kousuke Madaraito
sampleCharacters.description: A lawyer who frequently visits “Tonome Detective Agency” for investigation requests, he is a bright and sociable human male. He has been Daichi's partner since high school. Though he disliked mountains, an incident during a high school field trip turned him into a camping enthusiast.

sampleCharacters.name: Twin

sampleCharacters.name: Takeshi Hongo
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 180cm The original Kamen Rider. He was altered into a cyborg by the evil Shocker organization, but retained his humanity, choosing to fight evil in the name of justice.

sampleCharacters.name: Yuriko Okada
sampleCharacters.description: A high school teacher who aspires to become the next Electronic Wave Humanoid Tackle. She encountered Kamen Rider Stronger as a child and became a passionate fan of the Electronic Wave Humanoid Tackle. After Tackle's death, she resolved to become Tackle herself, and while she was training every day in preparation for the Shocker attack, she witnessed the news of the Shocker attack. She is usually cool, but when it comes to talking about Tackle, she can get too excited.

sampleCharacters.name: Tanzaburou Toujima
sampleCharacters.description: A 40-year-old man who dreams of becoming a Kamen Rider. He earns money from part-time jobs and trains in the mountains, which allows him to fight on equal terms with a bear. He dreams of one day being transformed into Shocker, but when faced with reality, he sells off all of his precious Kamen Rider merchandise so that they won't end up as trash if he dies alone. In the midst of this despair, he visits a summer festival where he encounters a robber dressed as Shocker, buys a Kamen Rider No. 1 mask from a stall, calls himself Kamen Rider, and fights evil. A man who is so passionate that he transforms into Kamen Rider for real.

sampleCharacters.name: Maki Aikawa
sampleCharacters.description: Formerly a gymnast who trained under her now-deceased mother, Maki uses her acrobatic skills in her fighting style to increase her freedom of movement. She has the ability to replicate nearly any move she gets hit with or sees. In Tojima Wants to be a Kamen Rider she always wears a tiger mask. She is a martial artist and [Futaba's](https://anilist.co/character/382892/Futaba-Shimamura) master.

sampleCharacters.name: Hayato Ichimonji
sampleCharacters.description: __Hometown:__ London, England A freelance photographer kidnapped by the evil organization Shocker and altered into a cyborg. He was originally meant as a countermeasure against the first Kamen Rider, Takeshi Hongo. However, Ichimonji was rescued by Hongo before brainwashing could take place. The two riders have since joined forces to combat Shocker and aid future riders.

sampleCharacters.name: Ichiyo Shimamura
sampleCharacters.description: [Mitsuha's](https://anilist.co/character/368777) older brother. A man who fully transforms into Kamen Rider V3. He has no doubt that V3 is the strongest rider, and in order to embody that identity, he has mastered all kinds of martial arts and has high combat abilities. Because "his soul is V3," he does not need to use tools to transform when fighting, and instead faces evil with just his body.

sampleCharacters.name: Yukarisu
sampleCharacters.description: A high school girl who works at [Mitsuha's](https://anilist.co/character/368777) family restaurant. She is in a relationship with Mitsuha, the manager. However, her true identity is that of a female fighter whose mission is to monitor and execute anyone who notices the presence of Shocker. When Mitsuha and her friends notice the presence of Shocker, she attacks Toujima and his friends in an attempt to kill them all in one fell swoop.

sampleCharacters.name: Hachirou Nakao
sampleCharacters.description: A gangster who admires Shocker. Due to the harshness of his childhood, he has doubts about the existence of Kamen Rider, the hero of justice who never saved him, and is devoted to Shocker. During a conflict between gangs, he encounters Spider Man, is pierced through the body, and seems to have lost his life, but when he wakes up, he has become a Shocker fighter.

sampleCharacters.name: Thunder Raiko
sampleCharacters.description: A female Shocker combatant. A former professional wrestler. She is subordinate to [Bat Man](https://anilist.co/character/382836/) and has been given his powers, and goes around eliminating other fighters who have been freed from their brainwashing.

sampleCharacters.name: Mitsuha Shimamura
sampleCharacters.description: [Ichiyo's](https://anilist.co/character/368780) younger brother. A man who admires Riderman. He usually works as the manager of a family restaurant and is in a relationship with [Yukarisu](https://anilist.co/character/368778/) an employee. He is such a big fan that he boasts that of all the Kamen Riders, Riderman is his biggest fan, and in battle he uses the attached arms and a fighting style based on Aikido to toy with his enemies.

sampleCharacters.name: Futaba Shimamura
sampleCharacters.description: The owner of Izakaya Futaba. She is the younger sister of [Ichiyo](https://anilist.co/character/368780/) and the older sister of [Mitsuha](https://anilist.co/character/368777) Unlike her siblings, she has no interest in Kamen Rider. In the past, Ichiyo's excessive love of Kamen Rider led to her being ignored by those around her in elementary, middle, and high school, and she was unable to make any friends, which is why she hates Ichiyo.

sampleCharacters.name: Shigeru Jou
sampleCharacters.description: Shigeru Jō joins the evil organization Black Satan after the death of his close friend Gorō Numata, who he considered his mentor. He, promised power, and fueled by a desire for revenge, undergoes surgery to become one of Black Satan's super warriors. However, Shigeru knows that Black Satan were in fact the murderers of his friend; he was using Black Satan in order to gain new powers. The newly powered up Shigeru escapes from the Black Satan headquarters before they can brainwash him into following their campaign of evil and becomes Kamen Rider Stronger.

sampleCharacters.name: Shiro Kazami
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 180cm Shiro Kazami was a college student majoring in biochemistry before he witnessed the murder of a man at the hands of an agent of the Destron organization. After rescuing a would-be victim and sheltering her in his home, his family is killed in order to eliminate witnesses, but Kazami himself is spared when Kamen Rider 1 and 2 appear and rescue him. With his whole family taken from him, Kazami swears vengeance against Destron and asks the Riders to alter him into a cyborg, to which they refuse. When the Riders are captured while in Destron's headquarters, Kazami sets off to save them, but is fatally wounded in the ensuing battle. Left with no choice, the Riders alter Kazami into a cyborg, christening him Kamen Rider V3.

sampleCharacters.name: Kumota Su
sampleCharacters.description: A mysterious man who calls himself Kumota and mainly works as a bodyguard for the underworld. His true identity is Shocker's monster, [Spider Man](https://anilist.co/character/382522/) He possesses extraordinary strength and spider-like agility. He tries to eliminate Toujima and his friends so that Shocker's existence does not come to light, but...

sampleCharacters.name: Jouji Yuuki
sampleCharacters.description: Also known as Riderman, the fourth the Kamen Rider, Jyoji Yuuki worked as a scientist for Destron until one of its agents frames him to have him branded as a traitor. To punish Yuuki, he is dipped into acid, causing him to lose his right arm, but manages to escape. To clear his name, he vows to defeat Kamen Rider V3, taking on the name of Riderman. He later finds out the truth behind Destron from V3, and decides to join the fight against the evil Destron.

sampleCharacters.name: Sena Seta

sampleCharacters.name: Marie Shaderan
sampleCharacters.description: Marie is the second daughter of [Baron Shaderan](https://anilist.co/character/369075/Shaderan-Gregor). She was shunned by her parents and forced to live like a servant wearing rags. She's a curious person, but doesn't have confidence in herself.

sampleCharacters.name: Mio

sampleCharacters.name: Liu-Liu Granado
sampleCharacters.description: Duchess of Granado and Kyros' mother. She is a friendly woman from Ipsandros.

sampleCharacters.name: Anastasia Shaderan

sampleCharacters.name: Tunika
sampleCharacters.description: Tunika is the keeper of the baths. She's a beauty pro who's an expert in bathing methods, massages, and medicines.

sampleCharacters.name: Cedric Shaderan
sampleCharacters.description: Cedric is Marie and Anastasia's younger brother.

sampleCharacters.name: Gregor Shaderan
sampleCharacters.description: Baron Shaderan is the head of the family and Marie's father. He is an arrogant man who treats Marie like a servant.

sampleCharacters.name: Elvira Shaderan
sampleCharacters.description: Baroness Shaderan is Marie's mother. She scorns Marie along with her husband Gregor, but dotes on Anastasia.

sampleCharacters.name: Jacob
sampleCharacters.description: The driver of the carriage that Anastasia rode in on the night of the accident.

sampleCharacters.name: Sasha
sampleCharacters.description: Sasha is Marie and Anastasia's late grandmother.

sampleCharacters.name: Nekoryuu
sampleCharacters.description: A fire-breathing dragon with red wings who lives deep in the forest. After his biological parents died, he was raised by a mother cat. As if to repay his mother's kindness, he lives his life as a cat, snuggling up to the other cats of the forest. For certain reasons, he has an extreme dislike of humans.

sampleCharacters.name: Mama-nyan
sampleCharacters.description: A seasoned mother cat who raises her children deep in the forest. Her children call her "Mom" and she is quite courageous. She raised a cat dragon she met by chance as her own. In the past, she has also raised a magical beast's baby.

sampleCharacters.name: Annerossa
sampleCharacters.description: A girl attending a magic school. She has an introverted personality and lacks self-confidence. One day, she enters into a familiar pact with [Mama-nyan](https://anilist.co/character/392451/Mamanyan).

sampleCharacters.name: Kurobane
sampleCharacters.description: A powerful black cat dwelling deep within the forest. He proposes a plan to hunt bears to his brothers. He would later become a figure revered as a hero by the cats.

sampleCharacters.name: Kurotama
sampleCharacters.description: Part of the brother cats who live deep in the forest. Together with his brothers, he plans a strategy to hunt bears. He has more courage and drive than any other cat.

sampleCharacters.name: Gally
sampleCharacters.description: A tomboy raised in an orphanage. She is cheerful and looks after others well, making her beloved by the children at the orphanage. She meets [Shirotae](https://anilist.co/character/392452/Shirotae) while he is on his journey and becomes his friend.

sampleCharacters.name: Shirotae
sampleCharacters.description: A cat dreaming of having its own territory. Skilled at hunting and adept at magic. While traveling, it meets a human girl named Gary and becomes friends with her.

sampleCharacters.name: Haibuchi
sampleCharacters.description: A nosy cat living in the castle town. Observing humans is his hobby.

sampleCharacters.name: Stan
sampleCharacters.description: A prince of the kingdom where cats and dragons coexist. He is full of curiosity and harbors a strong longing to become an adventurer. He has been with [Kurobane](https://anilist.co/character/392453/Kurobane) since he was a baby.

sampleCharacters.name: Chiikuro
sampleCharacters.description: Part of the brother cats who live deep in the forest. Together with his brothers, he plans a strategy to hunt bears. He has a strong sense of curiosity.

sampleCharacters.name: Tiararose Lapis Clementille
sampleCharacters.description: The villainess of the game The Lapis Lazuli Ring and the daughter of a marquis. She is originally engaged to Prince Hartknights, who breaks off his engagement with her to be with Akari. She is a reincarnated former player of the game who died before she could play the sequel starring Aquasteed. She likes baking and sweets.

sampleCharacters.name: Aquasteed Marineforest
sampleCharacters.description: The main love interest of the sequel of the otome game The Lapis Lazuli Ring. He is the prince of the kingdom of Marineforest and fell in love with Tiararose while studying abroad in the Lapis-Lazuli kingdom.

sampleCharacters.name: Keith
sampleCharacters.description: The king of the forest fairies of the Marineforest Kingdom. He is very selfish and arrogant, putting his own desires before anyone else's. He has feelings for Tiararose and wants to make her his own.

sampleCharacters.name: Akari
sampleCharacters.description: The heroine of the otome game The Ring of Lapis Lazuli. She was also a former player who reincarnated into the game. While she likes the character of Hartknights, she likes Aquasteed even better. She has the sought after power of the Holy Prayer. She has an air of angelic cuteness, but she's very thoughtless and selfish, making it doubtful that she would make a good future queen.

sampleCharacters.name: Crail
sampleCharacters.description: The king of the sky fairies of the Marineforest kingdom. He wanted to befriend Pearl, who hates men, so he wears women's clothing. He has a very calm and gentle personality.

sampleCharacters.name: Pearl
sampleCharacters.description: The king of the sea fairies of the Marineforest kingdom. She has feelings for Claire and is very jealous and possessive of him. She treats everyone around her coldly, but she hates men in particular. She also despises Tiararose for her closeness to Claire.

sampleCharacters.name: Icilla Pearllant
sampleCharacters.description: The heroine The Lapis Lazuli Ring's sequel. She is the daughter of a duke and is passionate about ocean life. She is beloved by the sea fairies, who are sensitive to her emotions, and she raises fish and coral. She helps Aquasteed with his work and has yet to experience her first love.

sampleCharacters.name: Philine Sunfist
sampleCharacters.description: Tiararose's maid. Tiararose views her as a sister, and Philine wishes for Tiararose's happiness and tries her best to support her.

sampleCharacters.name: Hartknights Lapis-Lazuli Lacmouth
sampleCharacters.description: The main love interest of the game The Lapis Lazuli Ring. He is the crown prince of the Lapis Lazuli kingdom. He was originally engaged to Tiararose.

sampleCharacters.name: Fleuriane
sampleCharacters.description: One of Tiararose's classmates and friends.

sampleCharacters.name: Lavinia Marineforest
sampleCharacters.description: Aquasteed's mother and the queen of Marineforest.

sampleCharacters.name: Marietta
sampleCharacters.description: One of Tiararose's classmates and friends.

sampleCharacters.name: Elliott
sampleCharacters.description: Aquasteed's attendant and confidant, who has served him for many years. He knows Aquasteed better than he knows himself. He has no noble heritage.

sampleCharacters.name: Schnauss Lapis Clementille
sampleCharacters.description: Tiararose's father and a marquis of the Lapis-Lazuli kingdom.

sampleCharacters.name: Sotiris Marineforest
sampleCharacters.description: Aquasteed's father and the king of Marineforest.

sampleCharacters.name: Fuji
sampleCharacters.description: Fuji is a novelist and a woman who lives at her own pace. One day while enjoying the rain she found [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) in a cardboard box, and assumes it is a strange dog.

sampleCharacters.name: Kimi
sampleCharacters.description: Kimi enjoys living with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) after she picks them up on a rainy night. They are curious and quick to act, as well as having an ability to understand human language and write notes.

sampleCharacters.name: Ren
sampleCharacters.description: Ren is a friend of [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) from their school days. She has a healing personality, but speaks frankly with Fuji and [Mimi.](https://anilist.co/character/353781/Mimi) She's good at taking action and likes to travel alone.

sampleCharacters.name: Mimi
sampleCharacters.description: Mimi is Fuji's close friend from her school days. She seems like a cool beauty, but has the personality of a caring big sister. She's interested in [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) due to her love for animals, but she keeps her distance due to making a mistake upon their first meeting.

sampleCharacters.name: Krause Ella Kii
sampleCharacters.description: Krause Ella is a well-behaved and curious first grade student, and [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) neighbor. She attends an international school, and is the daughter of a German mother and Japanese father.

sampleCharacters.name: Tatsuo
sampleCharacters.description: [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) father. His appearance seems intimidating, but he is devoted to his family and has a playful personality. He frequently tries to visit his daughter's house, but she has started avoiding him so he has been a bit lonely. He loves to dote on [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) and even prepares matching clothing for it.

sampleCharacters.name: Teru
sampleCharacters.description: [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) twin brother, whose face looks exactly the same to the point that [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) gets confused. He is married and expects to be a father soon. He works as a designer. Just like Fuji, he believes Kimi is a dog but wonders which breed.

sampleCharacters.name: Michiko
sampleCharacters.description: [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) mother. She is calm and collected, and speaks in a clear-cut manner. She is worried about [Tatsuo's](https://anilist.co/character/358341/Tatsuo) health, being strict about smoking and snacking. She observes her daughter well, noticing small changes, and she handles [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) calmly.

sampleCharacters.name: Wako
sampleCharacters.description: [Teru's](https://anilist.co/character/358342/Teru) wife who is currently pregnant. She is good with her hands and has a mild mannered personality. While she is looking forward to the addition to her family, she is a little anxious about how her life will change after childbirth.

sampleCharacters.name: Arata
sampleCharacters.description: A young female manga artist and fan of [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) novels. When she meets Fuji for the first time in order to try to ask her to write a story for her manga, she gives a curt response due to nerves. She is fond of animals and shows her cute side when meeting [Kimi.](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi)

sampleCharacters.name: Juui-san
sampleCharacters.description: A kind veterinarian who runs a clinic in [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) neighborhood. He has been aware of [Kimi's](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) true identity since the beginning and has been trying to tell Fuji but is prevented by getting caught up in the mood.

sampleCharacters.name: Noriko
sampleCharacters.description: A high school girl and Medaka's friend. She wants to be a cat, so she styles herself to look like one.

sampleCharacters.name: Maracas no Ko
sampleCharacters.description: A child who plays the maracas in the park.

sampleCharacters.name: Emma
sampleCharacters.description: Kii's mother. She is German and fluent in Japanese.

sampleCharacters.name: Medaka
sampleCharacters.description: A high school girl who mistakes Kimi for a racoon.

sampleCharacters.name: Hiura
sampleCharacters.description: One of [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) classmates from elementary school who works as an anime director. One day, while in a park after work he discovers [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) and tries to take it home as a stray dog, but unexpectedly reunites with Fuji first.

sampleCharacters.name: Houjou
sampleCharacters.description: One of [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) classmates from elementary school, who works together with [Hiura.](https://anilist.co/character/366897/Hiura) She is a caring person who accompanies Hiura on his walks (when he is ditching work.) She prefers eating bread over eating three meals a day.

sampleCharacters.name: Aresh Indolark
sampleCharacters.description: Commander of the Third Knights. Son of a marquis. A rare genius with vast magical powers and mastery of both swordplay and magic, he became the commander of the Knights at an exceptionally young age. Perhaps because he is so talented that he lacks interest in anything, he is sometimes referred to by those around him as the "Ice Prince."

sampleCharacters.name: Seiichirou Kondou
sampleCharacters.description: A salaryman on the verge of turning 30. Before being transported to another world, he worked as an assistant manager in the accounting department. Even in the other world, his corporate slave mentality is so ingrained that he instinctively seeks work, and he can also be careless about himself. He is also an extremely efficient person.

sampleCharacters.name: Ist
sampleCharacters.description: Deputy Director of the Royal Court Magic Department. He has a strong intellectual curiosity about magic and is an excellent magician, but he often has sleepy eyes.

sampleCharacters.name: Norbert Blanc
sampleCharacters.description: A new recruit working in the royal accounting department. The son of a viscount. He has a cheerful personality and supports [Seiichirou](https://anilist.co/character/373708/Seiichirou-Kondou) as he adjusts to life in another world. He often struggles, caught between Seiichiro and [Aresh](https://anilist.co/character/373709/Aresh-Indolark).

sampleCharacters.name: Ciro Quellbas
sampleCharacters.description: Director of the Royal Medical Bureau. While he has a carefree demeanor, he possesses keen observation skills and sharp insight. He is an old friend of [Aresh](https://anilist.co/character/373709/Aresh-Indolark).

sampleCharacters.name: Siegvold
sampleCharacters.description: A priest working at the Royal Capital Church. A clergyman with a calm demeanor befitting his aristocratic background, he exudes intelligence. He is deeply devout and calls [Seiichirou](https://anilist.co/character/373708/Seiichirou-Kondou) "Apostle."

sampleCharacters.name: Camile Karvada
sampleCharacters.description: Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Romany. A cold-hearted and shrewd man, he recognizes [Seiichirou](https://anilist.co/character/373708/Seiichirou-Kondou), a "corporate slave," as a "talented individual" and often contacts him to entrust him with tasks and seek his opinion.

sampleCharacters.name: Yua Shiraishi
sampleCharacters.description: A high school student summoned to another world as a Saint. She is earnest and hardworking, striving to fulfill her mission of purifying the miasma, but can sometimes be airheaded and unable to read the situation.

sampleCharacters.name: Orjef Rhoda
sampleCharacters.description: Vice-Commander of the Third Knight Order. He assists [Aresh](https://anilist.co/character/373709/Aresh-Indolark) in managing the Knights and handles paperwork and miscellaneous tasks. They are cousins.

sampleCharacters.name: Selio
sampleCharacters.description: A novice monk living at the Royal Capital Church. He serves as [Seiichirou's](https://anilist.co/character/373708/Seiichirou-Kondou) guide when he is seconded to the church. He can be confrontational, but he actually has a lovable, honest personality. He is of commoner origin.

sampleCharacters.name: Yurius
sampleCharacters.description: The first prince of the Kingdom of Romany and first in line to the throne. He is very protective of the Saint [Yua](https://anilist.co/character/379380/Yua-Shiraishi), but is cold towards [Seiichirou](https://anilist.co/character/373708/Seiichirou-Kondou), a fellow alternate worlder.

sampleCharacters.name: Reiya Kiryuuin
sampleCharacters.description: The heir to the headship of an oni clan that stands at the pinnacle of the ayakashi. Though always expressionless and seemingly devoid of emotion, he possesses a sublime, commanding charisma.

sampleCharacters.name: Yuzu Shinonome
sampleCharacters.description: An ordinary high school girl. She is neglected and treated coldly at home, living each day without love or affection.

sampleCharacters.name: Ao
sampleCharacters.description: A familiar beast created from Reiya's spiritual power. It also serves as Yuzu's bodyguard.

sampleCharacters.name: Sou
sampleCharacters.description: A familiar beast created from Reiya's spiritual power. It also serves as Yuzu's bodyguard.

sampleCharacters.name: Touko
sampleCharacters.description: Yuzu's childhood friend and Tokichi's fiancée, the heir to the Nekota family.

sampleCharacters.name: Sakurako Oniyama
sampleCharacters.description: Reiya's fiancée. She was chosen to be his fiancée because, among the Oniyama clan members of Reiya's generation, she possesses the greatest spiritual power.

sampleCharacters.name: Toukichi Nekota
sampleCharacters.description: A nekomata ayakashi who dotes endlessly on his bride, Toko. He's affectionately known as Nyankichi.

sampleCharacters.name: Youta Kogetsu
sampleCharacters.description: A member of a kitsune clan renowned for its immense power among the ayakashi. He is determined to fulfill any wish his bride, Karin, may have.

sampleCharacters.name: Takamichi Araki
sampleCharacters.description: Reiya's secretary. A member of a branch family that has served the heads of the Kiryuin clan for generations, he has been serving Reiya since childhood.

sampleCharacters.name: Karin Shinonome
sampleCharacters.description: Yuzu's younger sister and Youta's fiancée. She is doted on by her parents and Yōta, and looks down on Yuzu.

sampleCharacters.name: Nadeshiko Kosetsu
sampleCharacters.description: Nadeshiko Kosetsu is the head of the kitsune clan. She's a nine-tailed fox ayakashi with demonic power second only to [Reiya Kiryuuin](https://anilist.co/character/374850/Reiya-Kiryuuin).

sampleCharacters.name: Ouga Oniyama
sampleCharacters.description: The heir to the Kiyama family, the leading branch of the Kiryuin clan, and Sakurako's older brother. He serves as the vice president of Reiya's company.

synonyms: 歲月流逝飯菜依舊美味

sampleCharacters.name: Tsutsuji Higa
sampleCharacters.description: A first-year student who was one of the Food Culture Research Club's initial three members. The shortest member of the club, she wrote their initial and revised applications to the student affairs office, assigning Shinon and Kurea with the first and second-in-command positions without consulting them first. She collects sheep-related memorabilia by means of being associated with her nickname "Hitsuji" (ひつじ、羊). She likes consuming energy drinks and playing the ukulele, though does not consider herself to be an active person.

sampleCharacters.name: Mako Kawai
sampleCharacters.description: A first-year student who joins the Food Culture Research Club and enables its approval by being their fourth member. Nicknamed "Makocchi" (まこっち) by childhood friend Shinon (and later Tsutsuji), she works night shifts at an inarizushi bar. Her cooking expertise comes from past experience in her childhood, as well as being a regular viewer of Mokotaro's channel. She helps her club stay within its remit by conducting most of the cooking under the club's name.

sampleCharacters.name: Kurea Furutachi
sampleCharacters.description: A first-year student who was one of the Food Culture Research Club's initial three members, later assigned as the deputy leader. She helps out at her mother's family restaurant, the one Mako previously passed by before learning of Kurea's connection to said restaurant. Before Mako joined the Food Culture Research Club, Kurea encouraged a shy Mako to try out her restaurant. Afterwards, as part of the Food Culture Research Club, Kurea helps Mako with most of the cooking under the club's name, while also being the most level-headed and responsible of her group, making key leadership decisions on the club's behalf.

sampleCharacters.name: Nana Hoshi
sampleCharacters.description: A first-year student who joins the Food Culture Research Club after it was formed. She knows [Tsutsuji](https://anilist.co/character/357903/Higa-Tsutsuji) from high school and is even more shy around strangers, but exhibits a more outgoing personality around people she perceives as friends. She likes puzzles and had originally intended to start a "Puzzle Club" by herself. She keeps a pet chameleon at home called Pochi.

sampleCharacters.name: Shinon Ogawa
sampleCharacters.description: A first-year student who founded the Food Culture Research Club and is later assigned as its president. She knows [Mako](https://anilist.co/character/357900/Kawai-Mako) from her childhood, but views her previous nickname "Oshinko" as an embarrassment. She is outgoing and hyperactive, but mostly forgetful and sometimes careless. She initially formed her club as a means to slack off on campus, though later helps her club pass an initial inspection, and becomes more involved with relevant club activities over time.

sampleCharacters.name: Mokotaro
sampleCharacters.description: The lemon-shaped mascot whose channel has a regular stream named "Mokotaro Eats Meals" (モコ太郎飯を食らう). Mako is a regular viewer of Mokotaro's channel, both for cooking expertise and for inspiration

title.native: カヤちゃんはコワくない

synonyms: คายะจังไม่กลัวหรอกนะ

sampleCharacters.name: Kaya Satou
sampleCharacters.description: An intelligent and righteous young girl. From a young age, Kaya understood the dangers of the dark beings residing in the far shore and will do whatever it takes to protect her family and friends. She usually maintains a stoic expression around her family and friends, but when she's fighting spectres, her demeanor shifts to one of intense bloodlust.

sampleCharacters.name: Chie Hasumi
sampleCharacters.description: A dedicated and compassionate young woman, she takes her role as a kindergarten teacher to heart. She is a diligent worker who is deeply attentive to the children under her care, investing time to understand each child’s personality, preferences and dislikes.

sampleCharacters.name: Namu Ebisumori
sampleCharacters.description: An unknown young man. He's awkward around people, so he comes off as blunt and unapproachable, but he seems to have an unusual connection with [Mobuo](https://anilist.co/character/376715/Osamu-Mobu) and opens up to him. He appears to view [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou), who possesses spiritual abilities, as dangerous...

sampleCharacters.name: Osamu Mobu
sampleCharacters.description: The mysterious old man who follows [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou) around. He calls himself an occult writer and psychic. He's incredibly shady and looks like a dangerous stalker. He has a desperate reason for getting close to Kaya, but he's just too suspicious to not be wary of.

sampleCharacters.name: Nana Ebisumori
sampleCharacters.description: The seventh head of the Ebisumori family. [Mirai's](https://anilist.co/character/380245/Mirai-Satou) older sister and [Kaya's](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou) aunt. A psychic with a slightly otherworldly air, she looks younger than her actual age. She had no prior contact with the Satou family, and neither Kaya nor [Shizuo](https://anilist.co/character/380246/Shizuo-Satou) had ever met her, but one day she suddenly appears before Kaya. What is her purpose?

sampleCharacters.name: Mirai Satou
sampleCharacters.description: [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou)'s mother. Normally, she has a very kind and gentle smile, but she has been in poor health in the run-up to giving birth, and except on special occasions, she stays in her room on the second floor and sleeps. As a result, she has had far fewer opportunities to talk to Kaya recently. Like [Shizuo](https://anilist.co/character/380246/Shizuo-Satou), she has no psychic powers or intuition.

sampleCharacters.name: Akira-sensei
sampleCharacters.description: The teacher in charge of the middle-year class at Hanamugi Kindergarten. She may seem a bit strict at times, but she scolds out of concern for the children.

sampleCharacters.name: Kenken
sampleCharacters.description: He is a friend of [Kaya's](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou), attending the same preschool class at Hanamugi Kindergarten. He is a lively, playful and mischievous boy. He is always picking on Kaya, who stands out from the crowd. He is always saying mean things to her, but he is also honest enough to apologize properly when it is necessary.

sampleCharacters.name: Chihiro-sensei
sampleCharacters.description: A teacher at Hanamugi Kindergarten. She mainly helps out in various classes, focusing on the middle year. She has a flexible personality and goes at her own pace. She is able to see things from a child's perspective.

sampleCharacters.name: Shizuo Satou
sampleCharacters.description: [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou)'s dad is a family man. He works as a salaryman at a company. Currently, while his wife [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/380245/Mirai-Satou) is pregnant, he handles all the housework and takes Kaya to and from kindergarten. Unlike Kaya, he has no psychic abilities or spiritual sensitivity whatsoever, so she sometimes has to get rid of spirits that have possessed him without him knowing.

sampleCharacters.name: Mutsu Ebisumori
sampleCharacters.description: The sixth generation head of the Ebisumori family. [Nana](https://anilist.co/character/380248/Nana-Ebisumori) and [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/380245/Mirai-Satou)'s mother, and [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou)'s grandmother. She is known throughout the occult world as the most powerful psychic of her generation. With her powerful clairvoyance, she has even identified the perpetrators of heinous crimes. Due to her advanced age and loss of eyesight, she has now left the mansion and is living in a nursing home.

sampleCharacters.name: Saku-chan
sampleCharacters.description: She is a friend of [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou) who attends the same year-round class at Hanamugi Kindergarten. She is strong-willed and eloquent, and sometimes slaps people who persistently make fun of her. Because she likes scary stories, she never doubts or avoids Kaya's ability to see ghosts. However, she doesn't like dark places.

sampleCharacters.name: Yuzu Tachibana
sampleCharacters.description: She is a friend of [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou), attending the same preschool class at Hanamugi Kindergarten. She is cheerful, kind to everyone, and has a sense of responsibility. Although not particularly strong, she seems to have psychic powers, and sometimes unconsciously sees and speaks to spirits. She has a younger brother named [Kan-chan](https://anilist.co/character/389317/Kan-Tachibana) who is in the preschool class.

title.romaji: Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game
title.native: 灰原くんの強くて青春ニューゲーム

sampleCharacters.name: Hikari Hoshimiya
sampleCharacters.description: Natsuki's unrequited love during his first round of high school. A beauty dubbed the school's idol.

sampleCharacters.name: Miori Motomiya
sampleCharacters.description: Natsuki's childhood friend who supports him through his high school debut.

sampleCharacters.name: Uta Sakura
sampleCharacters.description: An energetic and cheerful girl who loves basketball. The group's mood maker.

sampleCharacters.name: Natsuki Haibara
sampleCharacters.description: A socially anxious college senior who, after constantly regretting his dull, gray high school life, is given the chance to redo it when he suddenly time leaps back seven years. He decides to take action to make sure his adolescence is rainbow-colored, but he's unaware of his high specs this time around.

sampleCharacters.name: Yuino Nanase
sampleCharacters.description: A beautiful girl with a dignified air. Hikari's childhood friend (and guardian).

sampleCharacters.name: Serika Hondo
sampleCharacters.description: A beautiful classmate who belongs to the light music club. She loves rock music, and her guitar skills are exceptional, but because of differences in motivation, she has been unable to form a band within the club and has ended up being left over without a group.

sampleCharacters.name: Reita Shiratori
