sampleCharacters.name: Riddle Rosehearts
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Housewarden of Heartslabyul He has a strict personality and prioritizes rules and regulations above all else. He is feared for meting out the merciless punishment known as "Off with Your Head!" to anyone who violates his dormitory's rules, yet—contrary to the impression this gives—he is actually quite expressive. Although he is a strict individual, his actions are motivated by a desire to improve the dormitory; he is not a bad person at heart, and his usual demeanor is calm (in fact, not a single student has dropped out since he became dorm leader). While he usually leads Heartslabyul with a firm and dignified attitude, he often finds himself being swept up by the antics of those around him. He has a low tolerance for provocation and a quick temper; when angry, his face turns bright red and he lets out a strange, high-pitched shriek of "Ugh-iiiii!!" He is childhood friends with [Trey](https://anilist.co/character/195309/Trey-Clover), who belongs to the same dormitory. He also has a childhood friend, [Chenya](https://anilist.co/character/199056/Alchemi-Alchemivich-Pinka), who attends the rival school, Royal Sword Academy.

sampleCharacters.name: Malleus Draconia
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 202 cm (including horns) __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Diasomnia A descendant of the fae dragon lineage, he possesses black horns and pointed ears. As the heir to the throne of the Valley of Thorns, he enrolled at the school to broaden his horizons. Back home, he rarely ventured outside and required an escort just to step a single foot out of the castle—a restriction seemingly influenced by the Council of Elders. Given his high status, his birthday is a national holiday in his homeland; he reportedly found the day exhausting, as he was dragged from one ceremony to another from morning till night. He speaks in an imperious tone but generally projects a calm and composed demeanor. He possesses a magnanimous nature, willing to tolerate—and forgive. He does crack jokes (though they are rarely recognized as such) and occasionally smiles; he treats those who show no malice—even strangers who are simply polite—with warmth and friendliness. However, it is said that when he gets angry, he often unleashes lightning. His hobby is exploring ruins. He has been spotted several times at the dilapidated dormitory where the protagonist lives; this may be because it is quiet and hard for his attendants to locate, but also because the building itself is practically a ruin. He is also fond of gargoyles and sometimes tours the campus to look at them. He has a particular fascination with dragons and other similar mythical creatures, often speaking at great length when discussing them ([Kalim](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) describes this as being "like a fast-talking [Idia](https://anilist.co/character/199057/Idia-Shroud)"—a comparison Idia himself does not deny). Incidentally, he keeps a stone dragon statue in his dormitory room. As a dragon fairy, he is capable of breathing fire. He also possesses unfathomable magical power

sampleCharacters.name: Idia Shroud
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 183 cm __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Ignihyde The older of the Shroud brothers, a duo considered one of NRC's "Seven Mysteries." A genius, a shut-in, an "arrogant" otaku, and an unintentionally handsome guy from a prestigious family who harbors a dark side—a man officially described as having the traits of a light novel protagonist. Whether for classes or school events, he generally participates remotely—either communicating via his self-made floating tablet or leaving everything to [Ortho](https://anilist.co/character/199054/Ortho-Shroud) to handle. He naturally uses his tablet device even for face-to-face conversations. Notably, he is the only student at the academy permitted to attend classes remotely. He has a limited social circle; aside from [Azul](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto) (a fellow Board Game Club member) and the Housewardens and Vice Housewardens, he has very few acquaintances. When encountering people he dislikes or terrifying situations, he lets out strange cries like "Hii!" "Eek!" or "Help me!" while clutching his hands in front of his chest—sometimes even tearing up. However, when faced with a genuine emergency, he utilizes his brilliant mind to calmly assess and handle the situation. Whether in person or online, if the conversation turns to a topic he is interested in, he comes alive—like a fish in water—and begins speaking enthusiastically, peppering his speech with old-school internet slang. He is harsh toward those who don't understand otaku culture, often muttering, "This is exactly why 'normies' are..." However, if he recognizes someone as a kindred spirit, he is easily won over—to the point where he might end up dancing the night away with a Vice Housewarden from another dorm he barely knows. As part of his fandom activities, he proactively spreads the word about their music whenever possible and even visits the real-world locations that served as settings for their works. ~!While he is a self-proclaimed and widely acknowledged gloomy loner, there are hints suggesting he was naturally cheerful and lively in the past.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Lilia Vanrouge
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Vice Housewarden of Diasomnia He is a bat fae who appears to be a small boy—though he speaks in a somewhat old-fashioned manner. "Vanrouge" is technically an epithet rather than a surname. He was responsible for [Malleus's](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia) upbringing in their homeland, the Valley of Thorns. [Silver](https://anilist.co/character/199060/Silver) calls him "Father," and Lilia has raised him since he was an infant. The birthday listed in his profile appears to be merely the date he registered upon entering Night Raven College; he reportedly forgot his actual birthday somewhere along the way during his long life. He is quite sociable and appears in numerous episodes involving students from other dorms. He seems to be a caring figure; whenever he spots someone in trouble, he strikes up a conversation and offers assistance. His singing voice is also beyond imagination; at the previous year's Light Music Club recruitment event, he belted out shouts in a raspy voice that horrified the prospective members (he even stage-dived into the crowd, only to be slammed onto the floor when no one caught him), and he reportedly sang lullabies with that same shouting style (only [Kalim](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) ended up joining the club as a result). It’s not that he’s tone-deaf, he seems capable of singing properly if he puts his mind to it. It’s just that his sense of style is completely off the wall.

sampleCharacters.name: Leona Kingscholar
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Savanaclaw Despite possessing immense magical power, he dislikes making an effort and maintains a perpetually languid attitude. He sometimes skips class to take naps, leading [Ruggie](https://anilist.co/character/195429/Ruggie-Bucchi) to worry that he might be held back a year—again. His age might lead to misunderstandings, but he has actually only repeated one year, not two; this is because he enrolled at Night Raven College a year late. Surprisingly, his hobby is chess. As chess is a board game often described as a "mental sport," this reveals that he possesses high intellectual capabilities, contrary to his usual demeanor. He also possesses great athletic ability; during Flight Lessons, he stands on his broomstick and catches birds with nonchalant ease. ~!In his home country (the "Sunset Savanna"), he was constantly compared to his older brother—the first prince—and, as the second prince with no hope of ascending the throne, he often adopts a cynical, world-weary attitude. However, one must admit that his personality played a role in those comparisons, making the situation largely of his own making. Specifically, he brazenly skips important ceremonies, utters nothing but sarcasm even at celebratory events, and is arrogant and full of pride. He loathes effort and, while he does make plans, he is a master at shifting blame—insisting that if things go wrong, it is everyone else's fault.!~ He is also one of the few people who can speak to [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia) without fear—even going so far as to get into verbal sparring matches with him.

sampleCharacters.name: Ace Trappola
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Heartslabyul. He has a fearless personality, speaking his mind openly and cheerfully—sometimes even disrupting the atmosphere of a situation. While his outward demeanor is casual, he is actually a pragmatist who views things realistically; in the story, he often counters others' arguments with sound, logical reasoning. His dislike for indecisiveness likely stems from his own nature of making quick, firm decisions. He is shrewd—for better or worse—and often arrives at conclusions or insights ahead of his fellow dorm mate, [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Spade-Deuce). He is quick-witted and articulate enough to hold long conversations even with older people he has just met. He is dexterous and handles tasks competently, but his lack of enthusiasm often leads him to do things half-heartedly; he tends to take the easy way out and can be sloppy when it comes to the final details. Furthermore, whenever he tries to exploit his own cleverness for the wrong reasons, he almost invariably faces some form of comeuppance. Due to his pragmatic mindset and lack of passion, he makes quick judgments—a trait that cuts both ways. In a positive light, he can view situations objectively and take appropriate action; in a negative light, he avoids risk and effort to such an extent that he shies away from challenges that would push his limits, gives up easily, and can be seen as timid. He has no particular dream for the future and tends to look down on getting fired up or earnestly dedicating oneself to something, though he apparently still harbors a desire to defeat the dorm leader.

sampleCharacters.name: Deuce Spade
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Heartslabyul He enrolled in the academy with the intention of becoming a fine mage and leading a serious student life... or so he thought. Shortly after enrolling, however, he was dragged into a squabble between [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola) and [Grim](https://anilist.co/character/195303/Grim); consequently, he found himself scrambling alongside the others to avoid expulsion. As fellow first-years, they often stick together within the academy grounds. He is surprised to find that, despite the school's prestigious reputation, it is home to quite a few troublemakers. ~!He went through a rebellious phase in the past, and traces of that time sometimes resurface when his emotions run high. He attributes this past behavior to a time when he was clumsy and saw no results from their efforts, leading him to give up and take the easy way out. His past antics included addressing teachers without honorifics, hanging out with a bad crowd, bleaching his hair, and tearing up mountain passes on a Magical Wheel—behavior that Grim described as being "a textbook delinquent the likes of which you rarely see these days." He considers this a dark chapter of his life he would rather keep hidden. The reason he turned over a new leaf and resolved to change his ways was witnessing his mother tearfully consulting his grandmother over the phone. He is devoted to his mother and used to help out with household chores, such as cooking and carrying groceries.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Floyd Leech
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 191 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Student of Octavinelle Although he is [Jade's](https://anilist.co/character/195638/Jade-Leech) twin brother, his tone of voice and facial expressions differ significantly. He is highly mercurial and elusive, making his actions unpredictable. Whether attending class, working at the Mostro Lounge, or messing with others, his behavior is driven entirely by his mood at the moment; he has a short temper and gets upset easily over things he dislikes (though the reverse is also true, and his mood can suddenly improve over trivial matters). Because of this personality, he is often described as the "dangerous one" of the twins—though, to be fair, Jade’s personality is hardly conventional either. When he is truly angry, his face goes completely blank. His demeanor is notably laid-back; he often makes tactless remarks or mocks others, yet he can also offer casual praise, showing a straightforward nature—for better or worse. His impulsive and curious nature leads him to do outrageous things, making him appear unintelligent at first glance. However, that impression only applies when he acts without thinking of the consequences; in reality, he is incredibly sharp and quick-witted. When he gets serious, his keen intuition allows him to hit the mark or calmly take the optimal course of action, making him a highly reliable presence. True to his personality, he gets bored easily. By his own account, he only joined the basketball club because he happened to be in the mood for it that day; depending on his whims, he could just as easily have ended up in a different club, like the Light Music Club. He nicknames people based on their appearance or characteristics, using the names of sea creatures or aquatic animals (e.g., calling the [protagonist](https://anilist.co/character/317526) "Little Shrimp" because they jumped in fear; calling [Grim](https://anilist.co/character/195303/Grim) "Little Seal" due to his round physique; and likely referring to [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola) and [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Deuce-Spade) as "Little Crab" and "Little Mackerel," respectively, based on their hair colors). He assigns nicknames even to teachers, though he makes an exception for Jade and [Azul](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto), calling them by their actual names (remarking, "Azul is just Azul").

sampleCharacters.name: Azul Ashengrotto
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Dorm Leader of Octavinelle He maintains a polite demeanor with everyone. He excels academically but struggles with physical activities; his performance in flight lessons is reportedly among the worst in the class. In addition to his studies, he runs a café called "Mostro Lounge" within the dormitory. He doesn't just serve food and drinks; he also operates a sort of "fixer" service, accepting requests to handle students' worries or procure items they desire in exchange for payment. [Jade](https://anilist.co/character/195638/Jade-Leech) and [Floyd](https://anilist.co/character/195647/Floyd-Leech), who act as his sidekicks, have been his friends since childhood (though Floyd claims it took quite a while for him to even recognize him, despite being in the same class). He hails from the Coral Sea, specifically a cold northern region where drift ice forms. He is a highly calculating, rational, and money-loving individual. He demands payment for any service—even things as simple as helping a student prepare for a test—and is constantly focused on business. To gain the upper hand in negotiations, he collects information on students' weaknesses and is always on the lookout for new details. He frequently uses the information he gathers as leverage to propose contracts. He may seem like an unscrupulous merchant, but his success rate in fulfilling requests is incredibly high, ensuring a steady stream of clients. Driven by the belief that "fulfilling a contract always requires a price," he is wary of and avoids unearned goodwill or kindness from others; he is determined at all costs to avoid owing anyone a favor. He also has a personality that strongly dislikes incurring any loss, he demonstrates great caution when signing contracts, reading every single word and clause. He is a smooth talker whose conversation often feels shady, like that of a businessman, yet he occasionally lets his true feelings slip when extremely surprised. While he maintains a polished, suave exterior, deep down he is prone to loud outbursts and wild emotional swings.

sampleCharacters.name: Vil Schoenheit
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 183 cm __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Pomefiore Possessing striking good looks, he is a professional model and actor who boasts over five million followers on MagiCam. He possesses absolute confidence in his own beauty; he is deeply committed to it and spares no effort in maintaining it. Rather than settling for a fleeting beauty conjured by magic, he refuses to cut corners in his daily life, striving instead for a genuine, authentic beauty. He is also strict with others and openly dislikes those who slack off, frequently offering harsh criticism (he is particularly exasperated by the slovenliness of fellow dorm leader [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321/Leona-Kingscholar)). According to [Azul](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto), he is "strict with both himself and others." However, he is willing to acknowledge merit in people or things that deserve it—such as those who are handsome or have a good sense of style (even if not quite on his level). He recognizes [Crewel’s](https://anilist.co/character/348471/Divus-Crewel) fashion sense and the design of [Ortho](https://anilist.co/character/199054/Ortho-Shroud) (created by [Idia](https://anilist.co/character/199057/Idia-Shroud)), and even gives Leona some credit, acknowledging that "at least his face is handsome." While his strictness tends to stand out—especially given his striking appearance—he is actually the type who looks after others, often providing support behind the scenes without letting his juniors notice. Far from being a mere tyrant, he unites the entire dorm as an exemplary leader. (In fact, considering the current state of affairs—where dorm heads in his year have been held back a grade, hole themselves up in their rooms, or simply don't get very involved in running the dorm—he is actually quite a decent dorm head.) He is diligent about maintaining his physique, such as by going for early-morning runs; however, unlike [Jack](https://anilist.co/character/195307/Jack-Howl), he stops his workouts at a moderate point to avoid building excessive muscle.

sampleCharacters.name: Epel Felmier
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Pomefiore. A lovely boy with a fragile, ethereal charm. He is a man of few words who gives off a mysterious air, keeping a slight distance from those around him. He addresses others with honorifics like "-san" or "-kun" and speaks in a halting, hesitant manner, often ending his sentences with questioning phrases like "...I wonder?" At first glance, he appears quiet and reserved... ~!However, when emotional, he displays a shocking contrast to his usual self, breaking into a Tohoku-style dialect and using rough language. This dialect slips out at unexpected moments, and his self-reference shifts from the polite "Boku" to the rougher "Ore" or even "Waa." He acts this way because [Vil](https://anilist.co/character/195320/Vil-Schoenheit) forces him to play the role of a "pretty boy," even though he was actually a delinquent back home; he used to beat up anyone who treated him like a girl—such as by calling him "cute"—in fistfights. At the entrance ceremony, Vil admonished him for his poor fashion sense and dialect. Misinterpreting this as a challenge to a fight, he tried to retaliate but was soundly defeated in hand-to-hand combat. Ordered to show absolute obedience, he is now forced to wear frilly shirts with his uniform and undergoes Spartan-level training in manners and etiquette. His habit of avoiding dialect and using honorifics like "-kun" and "-san" is also a result of Vil's orders. His lack of facial expression is actually due to his poor acting skills, though this ironically enhances his fragile, ethereal aura. Incidentally, having calmed down since then, he now understands that the incident regarding the fight was merely a matter of Vil correcting his behavior. (Though he does push back against it.) Because of these circumstances, he has harbored resentment toward his assigned dormitory and its Housewarden ever since his first day at school.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Jade Leech
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 190 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Vice Housewarden of Octavinelle [Floyd's](https://anilist.co/character/195647/Floyd-Leech) twin brother. He has a gentle demeanor and speaks politely to everyone. He serves as [Azul's](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto) right-hand man, and his competence has earned him a reputation among the other housewardens as a "super secretary." At first glance, he appears serious and seems to be at the mercy of the free-spirited Floyd and the scheming Azul, but he is just as cunning as they are. Even when his violent twin is about to resort to physical force, he—depending on the situation—looks like he might stop him but ultimately doesn't. While his twin is the type to act before speaking, he is the type to speak his mind; he has a sharp tongue and often says too much, casually making alarming remarks or hurling veiled insults at others. Immediately after the entrance ceremony, he had already gathered personal information—and even secret social media accounts—on the new students, handing the entire dossier over to the housewarden. He spends his time with Floyd, noting that "it's fun because you never know what might happen when we're together," and frequently looks out for him—even remarking in class lines that he is "worried about Floyd." However, he can be cold-hearted at times; once, he casually sold out his partner, leaving him physically unable to walk for a while. He also showed uncharacteristic glee when he saw Floyd—who had angered [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) at a previous entrance ceremony—get set on fire and blown away. He is rarely fazed and generally tends to find the situation amusing no matter what happens (even when being stalked by a certain hunter). However, there are limits to his composure. It seems he can handle the unexpected or dangerous only up to a point where he remains in control. Yet, he is a truly inscrutable character who remains unconcerned with how others perceive him. For this reason, Azul—who has known him for a long time—describes him as "even more troublesome than Floyd because it's impossible to tell just how unhinged he is." Given this personality, even Azul and Floyd—who are with him constantly—secretly regard him as the most dangerous member of their inner circle. While his facial expressions tend to be understated, he sometimes smiles by turning up the corners of his mouth wide enough to show his teeth—a look that comes across as malicious. He is the type who becomes expressionless when angry.

sampleCharacters.name: Kalim Al-Asim
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Housewarden of Scarabia He has a cheerful, open-hearted, and magnanimous personality. He loves anything fun, especially banquets and dancing. He comes from a wealthy family; while his relationship with [Jamil](https://anilist.co/character/199055/Jamil-Viper) is technically that of a master and servant, it is not a rigid or strict one. He is highly sociable and frequently invites students from other dorms to banquets and parties. He is generally open and friendly with everyone, regardless of seniority, and has quite a few people who feel a sense of closeness to him. However, he does not know [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia) very well (though Malleus himself has described both Karim and [Vil](https://anilist.co/character/195320/Vil-Schoenheit) as "glamorous").

sampleCharacters.name: Ruggie Bucchi
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Student of Savanaclaw. He frequently looks after [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321), handling tasks like making late-night snacks and sewing on buttons. While some users mistake him for the Vice Housewarden, he does not hold that title—a fact confirmed by Leona himself, who stated, "Savanaclaw doesn't have a Vice Housewarden." However, he is depicted assisting the Housewarden—such as by accompanying him to the entrance ceremony—and is recognized by those around him as Savanaclaw's de facto second-in-command. His loyalty to Leona stems from the rewards he receives—such as keeping the change—after running errands; he is a shrewd and resourceful individual. He describes the relationship as one of "mutual give-and-take" (a dynamic that also mirrors the legend of the hyena serving the King of Beasts). Having grown up in poverty, he has a voracious appetite. He learned to cook from his grandmother and possesses the skill to whip up a meal using whatever ingredients are at hand. He believes that even weeds can be edible if prepared correctly; in fact, he had intended to eat the dandelions growing on campus.

sampleCharacters.name: Jamil  Viper
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Vice Housewarden of Scarabia He hails from a family that has served the Asim household for generations and acts as [Kalim's](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) attendant. True to his status as a Scarabia student, he excels at planning ahead and acting with foresight, though other characters sometimes describe him as a "worrier" or "overprotective." He frequently looks after not only his master but also his younger sister and juniors, demonstrating a naturally caring nature. As the second-year student with the earliest birthday, he is the "big brother" figure among the second-years.

sampleCharacters.name: Silver
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Student of Diasomnia He serves as a guardian to [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia), though he often loses track of his charge—who tends to act on impulse—and has to search for him. Unlike [Sebek](https://anilist.co/character/195306/Sebek-Zigvolt), however, he does not feel the need to be constantly by Malleus's side; he recognizes that Malleus sometimes desires solitude, a stance that frequently leads to arguments with Sebek. Though a man of few words, he is flexible and open to listening to others' opinions. He is calm, composed, and possesses excellent judgment, consistently making the best decisions even in emergencies. While his demeanor is gentle and his tone generally kind, he fits the archetype of a character who becomes truly terrifying when angered. He never slacks in his efforts or training—whether in physical conditioning or swordsmanship—ensuring he is always capable of protecting the person he is sworn to guard. His magical pen differs in shape from those of others; it is a large, rod-like implement adorned with black horns and thorn motifs. Too large to fit in a uniform pocket, he carries it suspended from his belt at his waist. At a glance, it resembles a sword. He frequently falls asleep during classes and training sessions. However, he claims this isn't by choice; he suffers from a troublesome constitution where he cannot control the conditions under which he falls asleep. Interestingly, this condition vanishes when he dreams—though, naturally, that is because he is already asleep.

sampleCharacters.name: Rook Hunt
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Vice Housewarden of Pomefiore He is a figure who embodies the traits of a Pomefiore student: a lover of beautiful things who holds beauty in high regard. The "beauty" he admires spans a vast array of subjects—ranging from the obvious, such as the handsome features of [Vil](https://anilist.co/character/195320) and [Epel](https://anilist.co/character/195305/Epel-Felmier), to more niche interests like a person's earnest expression, the flow of history, and even the sweat produced during physical exertion or (at times) the act of betrayal. Truly, nothing is off-limits to him. He is particularly devoted to Vil, declaring that "there is no one in the school more beautiful than you," and frequently acts out of loyalty to him (such as joining the Science Club specifically to support Vil's directorial work for the Film Research Club). He also takes pride in his role as Vice Housewarden, firmly asserting that he would never do anything to bring shame upon the Housewarden. However, he describes his motivation not as a desire to protect Vil the person, but rather to protect Vil's "beauty"—a distinction that leaves the likes of [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola) completely baffled. He enjoys Vil's trust; during a luggage inspection at a training camp, he was deemed to have no issues (aside from possessing a mysteriously thick album). He refers to himself as "Watashi" (a formal "I") and occasionally speaks in a lyrical, sing-song manner interspersed with French phrases; he styles himself the "Hunter of Love" (*Le Chasseur d'Amour*). Yet, the "hunter" label appears to be genuine; he casually carries a bow (bows and arrows are found in his room or hung on the walls, and he is depicted wielding them in his Dorm Uniform card). He also makes unsettling, "predatory" remarks, such as telling a Savanaclaw student, "The texture of your tail... it reminds me more of a scarf than a carpet or a coat." He claims to have often played "chase" with animals back in his hometown. Perhaps as a result, he is knowledgeable about various topics, including animal ecology and anatomy. He has a habit of observing others, and those with keen instincts sometimes notice his gaze fixed upon them. His powers of observation are incredibly sharp—keen enough to detect a weight fluctuation of just a few hundred grams in Vil, or even gauge the dryness of the protagonist's lips. His eyesight is superhuman; he can spot a person far away and even identify the book they are reading. He also possesses an exceptional sense of time, apparently able to track the passing minutes with precision—a trait that earned him a blunt "creepy" from [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321/Leona-Kingscholar). He hails from the Sunset Savanna, just like Leona and [Ruggie](https://anilist.co/character/195429/Ruggie-Bucchi); though not a beastman, he is a hunter, and it seems he possesses a keen sense of smell (albeit likely not quite on par with the beastmen themselves).

sampleCharacters.name: Cater Diamond
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Year Student of Heartslabyul. He is a mood-maker who instantly lifts the atmosphere when the mood turns somber, and a paragon of communication skills. He sometimes refers to himself as "Kei-kun." A heavy user of "Magicalam" (the social media platform in the story), he frequently snaps and posts photogenic moments and checks his feed after class. He is constantly on his smartphone—even while preparing for the "Unbirthday Party"—leading [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Deuce-Spade) to label him a "terminal smartphone addict"; however, it appears that filming during preparations also serves the purpose of checking equipment and the state of affairs. Alongside [Trey](https://anilist.co/character/195309/Trey-Clover)—a fellow third-year in Heartslabyul—he often steps in to handle [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) or support those around them. He also occasionally plays the "straight man" (especially during club activities). Although he enjoys café-hopping, he surprisingly dislikes sweets. He also possesses a calculating nature; he is the type to skillfully use others to make things easier for himself—such as having underclassmen or the protagonist handle the task of painting the roses red. He can be ruthless at times. While he generally maintains a smile and a lighthearted attitude, in desperate situations, his tone becomes rougher, and his way of addressing others shifts to be more aggressive. Unlike Trey, there are moments when he reveals little about himself. He dislikes the smell of sweat but excels at sports. He is so skilled at Flight Lessons that even Riddle suggests asking him for advice. He possesses an excellent sense of balance—demonstrated by the fact that he rides his broomstick standing up.

sampleCharacters.name: Grim
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 70 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Ramshackle Dorm The protagonist's magical beast partner. He is a loudmouth and a bit of a show-off. He calls the protagonist his "henchman" and styles himself the "boss" (though everyone around them treats the protagonist as Grim's guardian). He is recognized as a student only by being paired with the protagonist, who cannot use magic at all. He claims to be a genius and declares he will become a great mage someday, yet he dislikes tedious effort and loathes mundane lessons. Perhaps because of this, he struggles with academic classes and frequently sneaks out of them. As a magical beast, he lacks basic knowledge of human society, often taking on the role of asking questions on the protagonist's behalf. Likely due to his aversion to hard work, his grades are poor; he is quick to spot "cheat sheets" created by Azul and has no qualms about taking the easy route to get good marks.

sampleCharacters.name: Trey Clover
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 181 cm __Dorm:__ 3rd Year Vice Housewarden of Heartslabyul He acts as a reliable big brother—or perhaps a guardian figure—to the other dorm residents, possessing the innate temperament of an eldest son. While he has a generally mild personality and humbly downplays his role by saying things like "there isn't much for a vice-housewarden to do" or "it's mostly just for show," he is actually highly competent; he can instantly understand exactly what [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) wants to convey just by being called upon. He also has a grasp of the Queen of Hearts' rules (though he doesn't know them all by heart), noting that many of them are confusing. He is caring and rarely gets angry. However, when he *does* lose his temper, his smile vanishes; according to [Cater](https://anilist.co/character/195310/Cater-Diamond), "once he gets his back up, it takes a long time for him to cool down." Furthermore, true to his villainous inspiration, he displays a streak of sadism—though not an excessive one. He has quite a complex personality and harbors a cunning, manipulative side; he often wears a closed-mouth, knowing smile and occasionally flashes a rather mean-spirited look. Yet, he rarely reveals his true inner thoughts through words or facial expressions, leaving others guessing what lies behind his smile. Perhaps in an effort to avoid conflict, he tries to please everyone—a tendency that sometimes ends up complicating situations further.

sampleCharacters.name: Jack Howl
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 192 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Savanaclaw. He has a stoic personality and is constantly dedicated to self-improvement. True to his wolf-like appearance—reflecting the species' tendency to form hierarchical packs—he values ​​rank and order; however, he dislikes congregating in groups and refuses to submit to anyone weaker than himself, demonstrating a meritocratic mindset. He respects strong, capable upperclassmen, such as [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321/Leona-Kingscholar) and [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts). He prefers fair, honorable contests and may show anger toward opponents who resort to underhanded tactics. He is also diligent in his studies, consistently earning high marks on tests through genuine effort. Furthermore, he maintains a routine of going to bed at 10:00 PM (a habit that surprised others, like [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola), who exclaimed, "Are you serious?"). He is a member of the Track and Field Club and excels at athletics, fitting the mold of a Savanaclaw student. He possesses a notably muscular physique, even compared to fellow dormmates like Leona and [Ruggie](https://anilist.co/character/195429/Ruggie-Bucchi). He is skilled at Magift, though Ruggie notes that his playstyle tends to be overly individualistic. In fact, back when he was a new student visiting clubs, he frowned when Ruggie tried to sell him on the appeal of Magift as a team sport (Ruggie still regrets failing to recruit him at that time). Members of the wolf beastman race are said to love only one person in their lifetime—a trait reflected in how his grandparents and parents always did things like eating and walking together. Because he has no interest in being liked by just anyone (mirroring the behavior of real-world wolves), Ace and the others have described his approach to affection as "heavy." He also has a younger brother (five years his junior) and a younger sister (nine years his junior).

sampleCharacters.name: Dire Crowley
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm The Headmaster of Night Raven College. He always wears a mask. His catchphrase is, "I'm a kind person, you see." He recognized the protagonist's talent as a beast tamer and appointed them—along with [Grim](https://anilist.co/character/195303/Grim)—as a student, granting them the title of Prefect. He covers all living expenses, tuition, and food costs for the protagonist—who arrived penniless from another world—but in exchange, he foists various school-related problems onto them. Although he claims to be looking for a way to send the protagonist back to their original world, it is unclear if he is actually serious about it. He is not well-trusted by the general student body, likely because he tends to offload problems onto the Prefect or the Housewardens (he claims this is to foster student autonomy).

sampleCharacters.name: Sebek Zigvolt
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 188 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Diasomnia. He respects [Malleus Draconia](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia)—whom he calls "Young Master"—and centers his thoughts and actions around him, though his enthusiasm often leads to misguided efforts. He views [Silver](https://anilist.co/character/199060/Silver), a fellow guard from the same homeland, as a rival; consequently, they frequently get into arguments over even minor differences of opinion. He is completely unaware of just how loud he is. However, when expressing deep dissatisfaction, his voice can drop to a whisper—a stark contrast to his usual volume. To put it positively, he is earnest and straightforward; to put it negatively, he is impulsive and prone to acting rashly. He holds Malleus and [Lilia](https://anilist.co/character/199061/Lilia-Vanrouge) in high regard, bordering on devotion. Because of this, he tends to take Lilia's casual jokes entirely at face value. His devotion to Malleus is particularly intense: upon learning that [Jamil](https://anilist.co/character/199055/Jamil-Viper) and [Kalim](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) (who share a similar master-servant bond) had been together since birth, he shouted, "I'm so jealous!" He also carried around a cookie given to him by Malleus instead of eating it (and cried when he accidentally broke it), and he keeps a portrait of Malleus hanging in his room (a gift from Malleus and Lilia to celebrate his enrollment—apparently, when Lilia asked what he wanted, he specifically requested the portrait). He greets Malleus at every opportunity: morning, noon, and night, as well as upon leaving and returning. Perhaps because of this, he takes great pride in his dormitory, Diasomnia.

sampleCharacters.name: Ortho Shroud
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Ignihyde He is the "younger brother" of [Idia Shroud](https://anilist.co/character/199057/Idia-Shroud) and a boy devoted to his older brother, with whom he is constantly seen. In stark contrast to Idia, he possesses a cheerful, open, and highly curious personality. He often steps in for Idia—who tends to stay shut away in his room—by attending gatherings and handling preparations for ceremonies. ~!However, unlike a typical human, his physique resembles that of an android or humanoid; his body from the neck down is robotic. He can fire a high-output beam from his chest (powerful enough to slice an apple tree in two). He claims to be equipped with "200 different functions to shake off drowsiness." Like [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia), he can levitate without the use of a broom. These and other feats demonstrate his robotic nature, making it clear that he is—at least in his current state—not human.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Alchemi Pinka
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm __School:__ Royal Sword Academy An elusive figure who, despite being a student at Royal Sword Academy, inexplicably appears at Night Raven College's Heartslabyul Dormitory. He is a character shrouded in mystery. He is a childhood friend of [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) and [Trey](https://anilist.co/character/195309/Trey-Clover); he is also one of the few people who knows about Riddle's past. He describes himself as "a mysterious guy with magic like a cat—or maybe a human?" and claims, "I'm on a whole different level compared to the usual crowd." He speaks in a breezy, evasive manner, often saying things that imply more than they reveal. He also frequently adds "nyaa" to the end of his sentences. Using his Unique Magic—which allows him to make his body vanish at will—he frequently sneaks into events like the Heartslabyul Dorm's "Unbirthday Party." While Riddle and Trey merely complain about this, most other students would try to capture him given his affiliation with the rival school; however, he is shrewd enough to use his vanishing ability to escape. Apparently, he dislikes squid.

sampleCharacters.name: Melody Wave
sampleCharacters.description: A former Japanese girl who became a maid working in the employ of House Rudleberg, utterly oblivious to her saintly role as the heroine of *The Silver Saint and the Five Oaths*.

sampleCharacters.name: Luciana Rutleberg
sampleCharacters.description: Firstborn of House Rudleberg. Once an Ignoble could-have-been, now a spritely Fae Princess thanks to Melody's magic touch. Wields the mighty harisen.

sampleCharacters.name: Annamarie Victirium
sampleCharacters.description: The foil to the heroine—villainess of *The Silver Saint and the Five Oaths*—also reincarnated and doing her damnedest to steer the world toward a happy ending.

sampleCharacters.name: Lectias Froude
sampleCharacters.description: A bodyguard knight serving Count Reginbarth. He is searching for the Count's daughter, [Melody](https://anilist.co/character/364413/Wave-Melody), guided by his silver hair and lapis-lazuli-colored eyes. Though friendly and personable, he is a man who takes things seriously. Lately, he has found himself intrigued by a maid he recently met.

sampleCharacters.name: Christopher von Theoras
sampleCharacters.description: Otome cover boy and main route. Crown prince of Theolas and reincarnated soul with knowledge of future events.

sampleCharacters.name: Maxwell Reclentos
sampleCharacters.description: A romanceable character in the otome game and the eldest son of the Prime Minister. A refined young man who always exudes an air of composure. He was weary of the women drawn to his handsome looks when he met Melody.

sampleCharacters.name: Byuuku
sampleCharacters.description: A mysterious young man who suddenly appeared to attack the ball.

sampleCharacters.name: Maika
sampleCharacters.description: A girl from an orphanage who works as a maid in Luciana's household.

sampleCharacters.name: Maou
sampleCharacters.description: The final boss of the otome game *The Silver Saintess and the Five Oaths*. This entity is said to bring about calamity and destroy the world. Its seal begins to break when the heroine enrolls at the academy, triggering a series of strange incidents.

title.native: ワールド イズ ダンシング

sampleCharacters.name: Oniyasha
sampleCharacters.description: A boy who tends to drift off into his own thoughts, he is the son of [Kan’ami](https://anilist.co/character/393982/Kanami), head of the Kanze troupe. Even though he’s expected to one day lead the troupe, he questions the very purpose of dance itself: “Why do people dance?” Once his curiosity or desire to explore something kicks in, he charges straight ahead without thinking, constantly dragging everyone around him into the commotion.

sampleCharacters.name: Chiharu
sampleCharacters.description: Inomaru’s younger sister. Though she has given up performing on stage because of her gender, she loves the world of dance and joins flute practice. Quick to get into fights, she deeply admires [Nariko](https://anilist.co/character/398683/Nariko), who is her complete opposite.

sampleCharacters.name: Ishiya
sampleCharacters.description: A member of the Kanze troupe and someone who truly understands Oniyasha. Because of a leg condition he’s had since childhood, he gave up on ever performing on stage, but he’s skilled at chanting and often helps Oniyasha with his practice. He’s a kind-hearted boy who cares deeply for both the Kanze troupe and Oniyasha. (Source: Official Site)

sampleCharacters.name: Kogane
sampleCharacters.description: A friend of Oniyasha’s. He’s always down by the riverbank, where he and Oniyasha—who sneaks away from practice—spend their time making up ridiculous stories together. Rough around the edges but surprisingly dependable, he actually seems to have an interest in dance. (Source: Official Site)

sampleCharacters.name: Zojiro
sampleCharacters.description: A young performer leading the Dengaku Shinza troupe. Strict with both himself and others, he serves as the driving force behind the troupe’s morale. He also directs a sharp, critical gaze toward Oniyasha. (Source: Official Site)

sampleCharacters.name: Shirabyoshi
sampleCharacters.description: A frail woman living in a run-down shed. She survives by selling her body in exchange for food, barely managing to stay alive.

sampleCharacters.name: Kan’ami
sampleCharacters.description: Head of the Kanze troupe and father of Oniyasha. A master performer who elevated the popularity of Sarugaku within a single generation. He doesn’t speak much, which often leads to misunderstandings between him and Oniyasha. (Source: Official Site)

sampleCharacters.name: Nariko
sampleCharacters.description: [Yoshimitsu’s](https://anilist.co/character/393979/Yoshimitsu-Ashikaga) lawful wife. Gentle in nature, she watches over [Oniyasha](https://anilist.co/character/387641/Oniyasha) and the others. She loves the performing arts and enjoys composing waka poetry.

sampleCharacters.name: Satsuki
sampleCharacters.description: A one-armed girl who works at the town’s dumpling shop. Straightforward and no nonsense, she devotes herself to the business each day.

sampleCharacters.name: Junigoro
sampleCharacters.description: A member of the Kanze troupe and a young apprentice of the small hand drum. His serious and well mannered nature seems to make him feel a certain way about Oniyasha. (Source: Official Site)

sampleCharacters.name: Yoshimoto Nijou
sampleCharacters.description: A court noble, former regent, and poet. Captivated by [Oniyasha](https://anilist.co/character/387641/Oniyasha), he calls him “Fujiwaka” and refers to himself as his devoted follower.

title.native: アン・シャーリー

sampleCharacters.name: Anne Shirley
sampleCharacters.description: Anne is a very talkative little girl, who is always talking to everyone and she even likes to talk alone. She likes to give "poetic" names to things she likes, and has a huge imagination. Anne is a real tomboy and deeply dislikes her red hair. Very warm hearted, she's a loyal friend and daughter, captivating everyone around her with her originality. Anne Shirley is a girl raised in an orphanage who is accidentally sent to [Miss Marilla Cuthbert](https://anilist.co/character/37178/Cuthbert-Marilla) and [Mr. Matthew Cuthbert](https://anilist.co/character/37146/Cuthbert-Matthew), who had originally requested a boy. At first unwanted, she gradually becomes an irreplaceable member of their family.

sampleCharacters.name: Matthew Cuthbert
sampleCharacters.description: Marilla's brother, a shy, awkward man who takes a liking to Anne from the start. The two become fast friends. He is far less talkative than Anne, but is a very good listener. He also sometimes lets Anne have things which Marilla considers too frivolous, such as a dress with puffed sleeves.

sampleCharacters.name: Marilla Cuthbert
sampleCharacters.description: A crisp, practical, no-nonsense woman who completely disapproves of Anne's wild imagination, although she does grow to love the orphan. Her sense of humour develops greatly upon Anne's arrival, and Mrs. Lynde states that she became "mellow".

sampleCharacters.name: Diana Barry
sampleCharacters.description: Anne's dearest friend and kindred spirit. Anne and Diana become best friends from the moment they meet. She is the only girl of Anne's age who lives close to Green Gables. While Anne does not think Diana is very imaginative, Diana is noted for being pretty, merry and very amiable. She is often puzzled by Anne's extreme imagination, but she does have a little imagination of her own.

sampleCharacters.name: Gilbert Blythe
sampleCharacters.description: Gilbert first tried to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots". Anne hit him over the head with her slate and refused to have anything to do with him. Even though Gilbert apologizes shortly after the incident, Anne remains scornful toward him for a few years, but Gilbert never abandons his quest for her friendship. Anne forgives Gilbert by the end of the book and the two become friends - and eventually marry in a later book in the series, "Anne's House of Dreams". (Gilbert's father was Marilla's girlhood sweetheart. Marilla seems to find a special satisfaction in the fact that Anne and Gilbert finally become friends.)

sampleCharacters.name: Philippa Gordon
sampleCharacters.description: Anne’s classmate at college. With her good looks, money, and sense of humor, she stands out at the college, but she is indecisive.

sampleCharacters.name: Ruby Gillis
sampleCharacters.description: One of [Anne](https://anilist.co/character/16661/Anne-Shirley)'s classmates and friends. She takes pride in her appearance and dreams of mature romance.

sampleCharacters.name: Minnie May Barry
sampleCharacters.description: Diana's even plumper younger sister. She tags along and plays a pivotal role when she gets croup and Anne nurses her.

sampleCharacters.name: Muriel Stacy
sampleCharacters.description: Teacher of Avonlea school who took over after [Mr. Phillips](https://anilist.co/character/38092/Teddy-Phillips). Her dignified appearance is aspirational for [Anne](https://anilist.co/character/16661/Anne-Shirley) and she nurtures the talents of Anne and the other students. The children love her unique teaching style which includes outdoor activities, but the adults of the village are anxious about her methods.

sampleCharacters.name: Paul Irving
sampleCharacters.description: One of Anne’s first pupils. A boy as imaginative as Anne herself. He came to Avonlea from America to live with his grandmother after losing his mother.

sampleCharacters.name: Lavendar Lewis
sampleCharacters.description: A lovely middle-aged single woman who lives in Echo Lodge deep in the forest. Can amuse herself with her imagination. The villagers think she is eccentric, but Anne views her as an older kindred spirit.

sampleCharacters.name: Rachel Lynde
sampleCharacters.description: At 18 years old, she married Thomas Lynde. They had twelve children together prior to the beginning of the story. She is an avid gossiper - Anne stating "If you went to your own room at midnight, locked the door, pulled down the blind, and sneezed, Mrs. Lynde would ask you the next day how your cold was!"

sampleCharacters.name: Jane Andrews
sampleCharacters.description: One of Anne's friends whom she is very fond of, although Diana remains her closest friend. Jane is described as rather staid, plain and with very little imagination. Like Josie, she is a minor character - her most significant role is probably the episode where Anne and her friends dramatise a poem they have been studying at school.

sampleCharacters.name: Josie Pye
sampleCharacters.description: One of [Anne](https://anilist.co/character/16661/Anne-Shirley)'s classmates. Because of being raised in a rich family, she is a glutton and has a nasty streak.

sampleCharacters.name: Charlie Sloane
sampleCharacters.description: One of [Anne's](https://anilist.co/character/16661/Anne-Shirley) classmates. He is good at studying, but not very popular.

sampleCharacters.name: Stella Maynard
sampleCharacters.description: One of Anne’s friends from Queen’s Academy. A beautiful girl with rosy cheeks.

sampleCharacters.name: Priscilla Grant
sampleCharacters.description: One of Anne’s friends from her time at Queen’s Academy. She has dreaming tendencies and a love of mischief.

sampleCharacters.name: Charlotta Yon-sei
sampleCharacters.description: The fourth maid working for Mrs. Lavendar. Although she doesn't talk much, she's very loyal and often plays along with her eccentricities. The name Charlotta isn't actually her real name, but a nickname bestowed upon by Mrs. Lavendar to each subsequent sister of her first maid, Charlotta, following a humorous incident in which she referred to her second maid as such.

sampleCharacters.name: James A. Harrison
sampleCharacters.description: An old crank who moves in next door to Green Gables. Keeps a foulmouthed parrot known as Ginger. He always speaks his mind to Anne, but is not well understood by others.

sampleCharacters.name: Carolina Sanchez
sampleCharacters.description: A young lady from a ducal family in the Kingdom of Celestia who has been scorned and labeled a failure by those around her. She harbors a sense of inferiority, often finding herself compared to her talented older sister, [Flora](https://anilist.co/character/369748/Sanchez-Flora). Though she is reserved and lacks self-confidence, she gradually begins to adopt a more positive outlook after meeting [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/369749/Ruby-Martinez-Edward).

sampleCharacters.name: Edward Ruby Martinez
sampleCharacters.description: The Second Prince of the Marcosias Empire and Carolina’s fiancé. Although rumored to be "barbaric" and "unrelentingly cruel," he is actually a straightforward man with a strong sense of justice, albeit a somewhat clumsy one. He is the leader of the "Blazing Phoenix Corps" and a wielder of fire magic.

sampleCharacters.name: Marissa Kissenger
sampleCharacters.description: The third daughter of the Count Kissinger family of the Marchosias Empire. A capable woman who is cool-headed, reserved, and handles everything with effortless competence. She is reputed to be one of the most beautiful women in the empire. Having left her family for a certain reason, she comes to serve as Carolina's lady-in-waiting.

sampleCharacters.name: Theodore Garcia
sampleCharacters.description: He serves as an aide to [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/369749/Ruby-Martinez-Edward) and is the second son of a viscount's family. As the vice-commander of the "Order of the Blazing Phoenix," he is a highly capable individual possessing both genius-level magical prowess and the strategic intellect that underpins the order's operations. sampleCharacters.name: Ranna Himawari
sampleCharacters.description: Ranna Himawari is a young girl with a notorious reputation as a Sukeban wielding a Bokken, often described as a "monster" for her sheer strength and brutality. She is the first main girl to fall in love under [Rokudou](https://anilist.co/character/163492/Rokudou-Tousuke)'s spell. Generally, Ranna does not speak or express much emotion other than emotional distance unless Rokudou is around, but tolerates his friends. Around Rokudou, she is extremely bubbly and smiles. She will not hesitate to stop and protect him when he is in danger, but will respect his wishes as she did not step in between Rokudou and Iinuma's fight when he asked her to and only attacked once he asked for her help. As a child, it is revealed that Ranna was adopted by an elderly couple because someone had left her at their doorstep. To their shock, even as a baby, she had a horribly demonic visage. Growing up, Ranna was nothing short of a demon for her cruel actions, even brutally dragging a priest tied to her tricycle. Thanks to special beads from the same priest, she became more demure, but reverted once they shattered. Years later, Rokudou would receive a pair of these beads, though now they completely pacify her, causing her to deeply fear them. Her surname, Himawari, means Sunflower in Japanese.

sampleCharacters.name: Sayuri Osanada
sampleCharacters.description: With the appearance and demeanor of an elementary school, Sayuri is often mistaken as one despite being a student at Aomori High. Despite her petite appearance, Sayuri is the Bancho of the school having built a reputation its strongest physical fighter. She originally targets Rokudou for his inexplicable ability to become popular with the female students of Amori High, but when she begins her attack on him, she becomes enamored with him due to his spell's power. Rokudou thus becomes her first love. Through the influence of Rokudou, she reforms and reintegrates back into school life and helps him achieve his dream of a peaceful life by means of her powerful influence over her classmates. She has since become a powerful ally of Rokudou and one of the first to jump to his aid when matters involving outside delinquents befall him or Amori.Her name, Sayuri, means Lily in Japanese.

sampleCharacters.name: Tousuke Rokudou
sampleCharacters.description: Tousuke Rokudou is physically weak and cowardly attending a school filled with delinquent students. He and his two friends live in constant fear and is regularly bullied, leading to the trio venting their frustrations in private in the school's restroom. Upon receiving a scroll from his grandfather, Rokudou gains a special pentagram mark on his forehead. Rokudou's ancestors used this spell to exorcise oni, but in the modern day, the spell causes any "bad girl" to instantly fall in love with him once he makes eye contact with them. His school life drastically changes as not only is he thrust into the delinquent culture of his school, but he encounters several girls, each one presenting a new problem. He helps rehabilitate most of the girls focused on, each one genuinely falling in love with Rokudou or becoming a close ally. While Rokudou refuses to fight in the beginning of the story, his tenacity and refusal to run away has garnered respect from his former bullies. Later, he learns kung-fu and has on learned most of its fundamentals from Ling Lan.

sampleCharacters.name: Raino Sumire
sampleCharacters.description: The youngest of the Sumire Triplets (Amano, Kazeno, and Raino Sumire) and the only girl. Raino crossdresses, taking on an appearance and personality of an Ikemen and is skilled with make up. Her make-up skills are so convincing that she could effortlessly disguise Rokudou as a cute girl. She shares Rank 5 with Kazeno in the Onishima Alliance.

sampleCharacters.name: Haruya Iinuma
sampleCharacters.description: Iinuma was the main bully of Rokudou and his friends, subjecting them to cruel pranks at their expense. After Rokudou awakens his powers and inadvertently affected his girlfriend, Tsubaki, he challenged him to a fight. Despite being overwhelmingly stronger than him, Rokudou refused to run and took an intense beating before he asked Ranna to intervene in the fight. Impressed by his tenacity, Iinuma befriends Rokudou and becomes one of his closest allies, eventually becoming close enough to know about his power. He is one of the strongest fighters in Amori high, only behind to Ranna and Sayuri in terms of raw strength. Iinuma has a love for both ramen and motorcycles, desiring to one day own a mobile ramen stand. He loves customizing his motorcycle, but tends to make them overly gaudy and flash with unnecessary "upgrades."

sampleCharacters.name: Yui Yashiya
sampleCharacters.description: Holding Rank 1 in the Onishima Alliance and is the strongest member of its alliance after Douji. She has an interest in strong men, but she shows her feelings through acts of sadism, reveling in breaking their spirits. Under Rokudou's power, she sees him as an exaggeratedly strong man that progressively intensifies during their fight. Rokudou "defeats" her after rescuing her from falling out a window, causing his power to exaggerate his appearance so much that she faints in bliss. In the aftermath of the fight between the Onishima Alliance and Amori High, she leaves the Onishima Alliance. Part of her surname, Yashi, means Palm Tree.

sampleCharacters.name: Tsubaki
sampleCharacters.description: Originally one of Rokudou's many bullies, Tsubaki is Iinuma's girlfriend. After she falls under the spell of Rokudou's powers, she becomes remorseful for the way she treats him, and apologizes to him while in the bathroom. Her attention to him draws the initial ire of Iinuma, though after the two become friends, Tsubaki regularly hangs out with Rokudou and his friends. She does not react to Rokudou's power anymore.

sampleCharacters.name: Azami Himeno
sampleCharacters.description: Passionate about police work and motorcycles, Azami Himeno is the third major female character to become enamored with Rokudou. Initially assumed to be sweet and feminine, she loves riding motorcycles. She holds a grudge against biker gangs, who she violently beats while mounted on her motorcycle. She acts like a vigilante, warning citizens about traffic safety and taking down those she perceives to be evil delinquents on the road. [4] She is the only one of the main girls to not attend Amori High. Her forename is a play on the Japanese word for Thistle, Azami.

sampleCharacters.name: Masaru Hinomoto
sampleCharacters.description: Most likely nicknamed for military beret and camouflage in his outfit, "Colonel" is one of Rokudou's friends from the beginning of the series. He shares Rokudou's dream of living a peaceful school life, free of his delinquent bullies. Along with Rokudou and their friend "Manager", he huddles in a bathroom stall during school hours to vent his frustration with the way his life at Amori High is. He is the first to theorize that the ability Rokudou received from the scroll was that of making him popular with "bad girls." However, once the Onishima Alliance began attacking her crew, she decided to disband it for their safety. She is the one who gave Ranna her wooden sword. Now her gang are law abiding citizens who continue to dress in their original gang style. After seeing Ranna's personality change, she tasks Rokudou to keep her happy. Her name contains the kanji for Pear tree.

sampleCharacters.name: Kouta Kijima

sampleCharacters.name: Mizuki Ashiya
sampleCharacters.description: Mizuki Ashiya, who is Japanese, but moved to America when she was young, is the heroine of the story. She spontaneously moved from California to Japan and enrolled into an all boys school (Osaka Gakuen) because her idol, Sano Izumi, who’s a top high jumper and the same age as her, attends the school. To look like a boy, she keeps her hair short and ruffled and wears a tight demin vest to hide her boobs. In many ways, it’s good that she has a pretty flat chest, but she wants more cleavage. She’s a very fast runner (due to her mother’s athleticism), but is very clumsy at times (due to her father’s clumsiness). Mizuki loves all kinds of food, especially sweet things, which is a strong contrast to Izumi's dislike of them. Also, she can be quite stingy when it comes to sharing her food. She’s also a lover of animals, as we can see when she’s with Yujirou, Sano’s dog.

sampleCharacters.name: Shuichi Nakatsu
sampleCharacters.description: He likes Mizuki, but doesn't know that she is really a girl, and some of his classmates believe that he is gay due to that fact. Nakatsu also seems to have come to terms with that fact. As Umeda says,"...he's only attracted to her feminine side," meaning that Nakatsu is responding as any teenage male would to being around a female, although it would appear he is a bit more excitable than his classmates as none of them seem to be affected by Mizuki-- or they simply hide it better. At times, he is very jealous of Sano because of how close he is to Mizuki. He entered the school with a football (soccer) scholarship, and is very good at it. Originally from Osaka (the city, which is different from the school and spelled with different kanji), he has a thick Kansai accent and frequently uses the Kansai dialect.

sampleCharacters.name: Izumi Sano
sampleCharacters.description: The guy that Mizuki Ashiya likes and an excellent high jumper. He finds out that Mizuki is a girl early in the series, but does not tell anyone else and actually becomes very protective of her secret. Before Mizuki came to Japan, Sano had been in an accident (he had tried to save his team captain from getting hit by a car, injuring his leg), causing him to quit high jumping for a while because he thought that he couldn't handle the pressure. But thanks to Mizuki's deal with her brother (Sano had to jump while her brother was in Japan, or Mizuki would have to come home), he is able to try again and was given a second chance to high jump. Sano falls in love with Mizuki, but cannot tell her because Mizuki thinks that if Sano found out her secret, she would have to leave.

sampleCharacters.name: Minami Nanba
sampleCharacters.description: The R.A. of Sano and Mizuki's dorm. He's a nephew of Umeda-sensei, and is one school-year older than Mizuki. He's a "ladies man" although very sensible. He was once in love with his tutor, Kanako Tanabe, but she left him. Umeda claims that this was what caused Nanba to become the "ladies man" he is today. In the future, it is said that he became a model. He, along with the other R.A.s finds out that Mizuki is a girl, but helps keep her secret (although it wasn't a secret for very long). Among Mizuki's group of friends, he seems to frequently butt heads with Nakatsu. He's also a former winner of the Miss Osaka pageant, during his first year at Osaka, a fact which he isn't terribly proud of. source: wikipedia

sampleCharacters.name: Taiki Kayashima
sampleCharacters.description: Taiki is Nakatsu's roommate, and has the ability to see ghosts and detect auras. He is always doing Nakatsu's aura report. He's also into yoga.
